hemomancy.acolyte.about_clarity.line1: Clarity comes after purity. Quiet the infection first, then learn to see without fever.
hemomancy.acolyte.about_clarity.line2: Consecrated copper holds the lesson of endurance: it changed, oxidized, and became stable.
hemomancy.acolyte.about_clarity.line3: When your blood is fully pale, that lesson can become a halo rather than a wound.
hemomancy.acolyte.absolved.line1: Most of the old red has gone pale. You may mourn it. Many do.
hemomancy.acolyte.absolved.line2: Let the grief pass through clean water. What remains will be yours in a way the blood never was.
hemomancy.acolyte.clarity.line1: The second water has taken you. Your blood is quiet now, so the world has room to shout.
hemomancy.acolyte.clarity.line2: Sharp sight can still lie to you. The clearest eye may turn merciless.
hemomancy.acolyte.cleansing.line1: You stand in the long middle now. The blood has learned fear, and frightened things cling.
hemomancy.acolyte.cleansing.line2: The Silver Veil may settle over you in danger. Treat it as a quiet instruction and leave the closing wound alone.
hemomancy.acolyte.corrupted.line1: The first dose has opened the wound. That pain means the blood-memory is losing certainty.
hemomancy.acolyte.corrupted.line2: Move carefully. The old current will still answer if you call it, and every call teaches it your name again.
hemomancy.acolyte.enlightened.line1: §7[The Acolyte bows until their forehead nearly touches their clasped hands]
hemomancy.acolyte.enlightened.line2: The Lady weeps for joy, or for warning. With the Unstained, those tears are often the same water.
hemomancy.acolyte.how_clarity.line1: Clarity is awakened through consecrated copper, then deepened by offerings that teach perception instead of hunger.
hemomancy.acolyte.how_clarity.line2: Silver chalices, hemolytic plating, and verdigris rites strengthen the halo that purity made possible.
hemomancy.acolyte.how_purify.line1: Purity grows through restraint, mercy, and offerings that ask nothing of blood.
hemomancy.acolyte.how_purify.line2: Hemolytic solution begins the work. Lethean flowers, pale dew, sleep, clean labor, and spared life continue it.
hemomancy.acolyte.how_purify.line3: Slow down. A wound closed too quickly keeps rot beneath the skin.
hemomancy.acolyte.lady_lore.line1: Our Lady of Still Waters lives where fever breaks. The sky has nothing to do with her.
hemomancy.acolyte.lady_lore.line2: When the crimson fungus spread through blood and memory, the world answered as bodies answer infection.
hemomancy.acolyte.lady_lore.line3: She is that answer given face and patience. Defensive, not cruel. Still, not empty.
hemomancy.acolyte.not_on_path.line1: §7[The Acolyte lowers their voice as the church air cools around you]
hemomancy.acolyte.not_on_path.line2: You have not begun the washing. If the blood troubles you, speak with a Zealot and approach the podium with hemolytic solution.
hemomancy.acolyte.purified.line1: Your blood is white in the way winter bone is white. The first transformation has fixed itself.
hemomancy.acolyte.purified.line2: If you choose clarity, bring consecrated copper to the podium and let the last crimson habit fall silent.
hemomancy.acolyte.silver_veil.line1: The Silver Veil is the inner skin of purification. It keeps the crimson current at a distance.
hemomancy.acolyte.silver_veil.line2: The Veil gives you distance. From there, choice becomes possible.
hemomancy.acolyte.tainted.line1: The stain is thinning. You may feel hollow where power used to answer.
hemomancy.acolyte.tainted.line2: That hollow place is space returning to you.
hemomancy.acolyte.verdigris.line1: Verdigris is copper after long exposure, changed without surrendering its work.
hemomancy.acolyte.verdigris.line2: Purity comes after contact. What matters is surviving it honestly.
hemomancy.acolyte.who_are_you.line1: We are keepers of still water: not judges first, not executioners first, but witnesses to what infection does to the self.
hemomancy.acolyte.who_are_you.line2: Some of us were Harbingers. Some were family to Harbingers. All of us know the crimson is easier to inherit than to shed.
hemomancy.alchemist.adept.chisel_lore: The Chisel Station lets you inscribe rune patterns into prepared materials, encoding specific arcane functions. Rune crafting requires mastery of Degree Four — what you have just achieved. Study the rune patterns carefully; each combination produces a different functional result.
hemomancy.alchemist.adept.line1: §7[The Alchemist sets down a precision tool and turns to you with a look of genuine respect]
hemomancy.alchemist.adept.line2: Adept of the Brotherhood. You have proven you can work with the machines. Now I can show you the stations that work on you.
hemomancy.alchemist.adept.scar_station_l: The Cerebral Scarring Station is a surgical instrument as much as a crafting bench. Using a knapper, you carve sacred patterns onto blank scar plates. Once worn, these patterns open new neural and venous pathways within the mind. Each scar changes which manipulations you can sustain and how strongly your tendencies express themselves.
hemomancy.alchemist.apotheos.line1: §4[The Alchemist stops entirely and looks at you for a long moment with an expression that is equal parts awe and something almost like vertigo.]
hemomancy.alchemist.apotheos.line2: Apotheos. §oI built machines to process blood. I never understood that the machines were always pointing at §4§osomething§r. I understand now. There is nothing left for me to teach you. Your blood knew it before I did.
hemomancy.alchemist.apotheos.reflection: §oThe Alembic distils. The Centrifuge separates. The Loom weaves. The Incubator grows. I spent my life in the belief that these were the end of it — the summit of hemomantic engineering. But they are not the summit. §4§oYou§r are the summit. The machines were never the product. You were. I was building toward you.
hemomancy.alchemist.archon.line1: §4[The Alchemist straightens instinctively and bows their head]
hemomancy.alchemist.archon.line2: Archon. Every machine in this Outpost is yours to command. I have no lessons left for you. I can only keep the machines serving.
hemomancy.alchemist.clarity.line1: §7[The Alchemist looks straight through you as though you are not there, then returns their attention to their work without a word]
hemomancy.alchemist.first_separation.bri: Take these two loose Blood Vials. Left-click one living creature with each vial; the vial cancels the hit. Set the samples in opposing centrifuge slots and recover that spin's enzyme.
hemomancy.alchemist.first_separation.com: Good. The enzyme held its shape. Take this field kit and learn to draw the next answer yourself.
hemomancy.alchemist.enzyme_uses.brewing: In an ordinary brewing stand: Vivacious makes Regeneration; Fervent, Fire Resistance; Neurotic, Swiftness; Incandescent, Night Vision; Ruinous, Poison; Frigid, Slowness; and Ferric, Strength. Umbral turns Night Vision into Invisibility.
hemomancy.alchemist.enzyme_uses.culture: At Degree 3, combine an enzyme with a Spore Sac and Hyphal Substrate to make its matching culture. A Mycelial Lantern keeps that culture and fruits the same enzyme for 600 blood over 2,400 ticks.
hemomancy.alchemist.enzyme_uses.workshop: That is your first living workshop: the Centrifuge discovers an expression, the culture preserves it, and a Gourdvine Tap can supply the Lantern without replacing active blood gathering.
hemomancy.alchemist.illuminatus.incubato: The Morphling Incubator raises cultivated fungal symbionts through controlled conditions. Wild polyps carry possibilities; incubation makes one strain stable enough to live with you.
hemomancy.alchemist.illuminatus.line1: Illuminatus of the Crimson Lodge. Few ever reach this stage of understanding. The machines at this level operate on principles the uninitiated would call impossible.
hemomancy.alchemist.initiate.line1: Initiate of the Incarnadine Fane. You are ready to understand the Somatic Loom, the heart of this Outpost's advanced processes.
hemomancy.alchemist.initiate.loom_lore: The Somatic Loom is a physical memory rite: prepare a blank vessel and catalyst, store the required enzyme colours, project blood, then draw the scattered memory-orbs home with the Living Staff.
hemomancy.alchemist.initiate.memory_weav: Memory weaving puts the manipulation into the completed memory. At the Reliquary, that memory already knows its lesson. The Reliquary only chooses which known lessons remain active.
hemomancy.alchemist.initiate.mnemonist_b: You have catalogued enough red expression for the next lesson. Take a blank vessel to the Mnemonist; they will show you how a memory is made ready before the Loom writes anything into it.
hemomancy.alchemist.item_hint: Show me what you carry. I will name what belongs to my bench.
hemomancy.alchemist.item_inquiry.barbed_: The Barbed Blade draws blood on contact through living extensions in its barbs. Each hit returns a little to the wielder's reserve. The return is small, but it keeps coming during a long fight.
The blade gathers better than it kills. Use it when you need to fight and refill your reserve at the same time. Choose another tool when the target needs to die quickly.
hemomancy.alchemist.item_inquiry.blaze_p: Blaze powder. A volatile combustion compound from the Nether. In the Alembic, its ignition chemistry processes as a quality Flammeus tendency input and strips into Fervent Enzyme concentrate.
Handle with care during transport. Blaze powder ignites from friction. Keep it dry, away from blood vials, and well away from open flame until you intend to use it.
hemomancy.alchemist.item_inquiry.blood_c: Blood crystal shard. A fragment of crystallised sanguine energy with lower purity than a full formation. It remains useful as a lower-tier Alembic input or supplementary ingredient.
Keep them. The Alembic accepts them at reduced yield. Accumulate enough for a worthwhile batch.
hemomancy.alchemist.item_inquiry.blood_g: The blood gourd is your primary storage vessel. Upgrade it as initiation deepens. More room means a deeper reserve and longer casting.
White, Red, then Black. Each tier adds capacity. Treat White as a starting tier.
hemomancy.alchemist.item_inquiry.blood_v: Left-click a living creature with an empty Blood Vial to draw a sample without damaging it. The Living Syringe and rack make repeated field sampling faster later.
Balance the sampled vials in the Centrifuge, then recover the separated enzyme. That is the process.
hemomancy.alchemist.item_inquiry.bloody_: A Bloody Flask is a portable reserve, not part of the syringe-and-rack assay.
Use it when blood must travel. A machine accepts either vessel as red fluid.
hemomancy.alchemist.item_inquiry.brewing: A brewing stand is the common practitioner's distillation device. Its water-and-base process gives blunt biological responses. It is the Alembic's rough ancestor, like boiling meat over a fire before learning to cook.

The Alembic makes precise tendency concentrates. The stand makes threshold effects. Both distil, but the Alembic resolves the result more finely. A familiar stand will not teach you what its successor is doing.
hemomancy.alchemist.item_inquiry.chalybe: Iron sulfide in a living skirt. A ridiculous phrase, and yet the snail makes it work.
Knap it while the creature is withdrawn. If you must kill for scraps, you have already failed the material.
hemomancy.alchemist.item_inquiry.cleansi: Cleansing hemolymph. A blue-tinted lytic fluid derived from a Hemolymphopoda, whose circulatory chemistry opposes standard blood-matrix compounds.
Technically, it is an efficient lytic agent with stable properties. What others use it for is outside my concern.
hemomancy.alchemist.item_inquiry.dendrit: The Dendritic Distributor preserves the arrangement of a whole manipulation loadout as a remembered neural pattern. Learn the memories elsewhere, then let this station keep their order.
Saving or overwriting a pattern costs blood and raw experience. The nervous lattice can remember three patterns by default, with deeper synaptic discipline opening more.
hemomancy.alchemist.item_inquiry.dicentr: Dicentra sap is an older preparation of Bleeding Heart fluid. The Order now prefers the intact bulb, but old stores can still be rendered into usable reagent mass.
If you find sealed sap in old stores, distill it into Bleeding Bulbs before committing it to modern hemomantic formulae.
hemomancy.alchemist.item_inquiry.enzyme_: Ferric Enzyme, Ferric tendency. Ferric is the iron tendency: blood that conducts, reinforces, and binds structure. Ferric manipulations harden the body and channel energy with precision.
Ferric concentrates from metallic or mineral-dense organic compounds. Its measured conductivity makes it especially useful wherever a stable metallic reagent is called for.
Fervent Enzyme, Flammeus tendency. Flammeus is the combustion tendency: heat, ignition, volatile pressure. Fervent manipulations channel blood-heat outward.
Distil combustible compounds in the Alembic, then centrifuge the enriched output.
Frigid Enzyme, Congeatio tendency. Congeatio is the stasis tendency: blood made cold, slow, crystalline. Frigid manipulations immobilise, preserve, and impose stillness.
Congeatio concentrates from materials exhibiting natural preservation or cold-resistance run through the Alembic.
Incandescent Enzyme, Lux tendency. Lux is the radiance tendency: blood as light-bearer, illusory force, perceptual distortion. Incandescent manipulations bend what can be seen.
Lux concentrates from luminescent organic materials run through the Alembic.
Neurotic Enzyme, Ductilis tendency. Nerve impulse, acceleration, transmission, and motion made chemically legible.
It belongs wherever a recipe asks blood to carry a signal rather than merely hold a shape.
Ruinous Enzyme, Mortem tendency. Mortem is the entropy tendency: breakdown, dissolution, the blood as agent of ending. Ruinous manipulations accelerate decay and sap vitality.
Mortem concentrates from decomposing organic materials in the Alembic. The Covenant treats it with appropriate wariness.
Umbral Enzyme, Tenebris tendency. Tenebris is the shadow tendency: blood drawn away from light, into concealment. Umbral manipulations suppress visibility and dampen perception.
Tenebris concentrates from materials with natural darkness affinity run through the Alembic.

Vivacious Enzyme, Animus tendency. Animus is the tendency of life-force: movement, vitality, the body's will to continue. Its manipulations accelerate healing, increase physical speed, and keep the body working under strain.
Obtain it by running enriched blood samples through the Vial Centrifuge after distilling organic life-force materials in the Alembic.
hemomancy.alchemist.item_inquiry.erythro: Cut cleanly and it remains useful. Tear it apart and you mostly get wet pulp with ambitions.
The reef grows in beds. Harvest it like a garden, not a mine.
hemomancy.alchemist.item_inquiry.foul_pa: Foul Paste. A dense organically derived binding substrate. Keep it sealed and use only the measured quantity called for by a recipe.
The Alembic produces it from specific organic inputs. Keep a steady supply. Interruptions waste precious reagent.
hemomancy.alchemist.item_inquiry.fungal_: The Fungal Implantation Pylon installs one cultivated fungal scar. It can replace or remove that scar while the number of fungal slots stays fixed.
At Degree 4, activate its Blood Structure through the Hematic Iron heart with Hyphal Substrate in hand.
The implantation pylon belongs to Degree 4 scar work. Cultivate the fungal scar first, then build the station when you can use it.
hemomancy.alchemist.item_inquiry.ghastly: The Ghastly Alembic is the first machine in the Harbinger's toolkit. It receives raw organic inputs and distils them into concentrated alchemical compounds.
Blood vials, enriched extracts, and foul paste all come from the Alembic. Learn its inputs first. Everything downstream depends on them.
hemomancy.alchemist.item_inquiry.glass_b: A glass bottle is a common alchemical vessel. It holds liquid and seals well enough, but pressure will shatter it. Blood vials use a calibrated volume that ordinary glassware cannot match.
Use it for unstabilised material that has no place in a blood vial. Blood distillation, processing, and tendency work belong in the proper vessel.
hemomancy.alchemist.item_inquiry.glowsto: Glowstone dust. A luminescent mineral compound from the Nether. In the Alembic, its light chemistry processes as a quality Lux tendency input and strips into Incandescent Enzyme concentrate.
Glowstone dust gives a good Incandescent Enzyme yield. Extraction is clean, with little waste. For Lux tendency work, it is one of the most reliable conventional inputs.
hemomancy.alchemist.item_inquiry.hematic: Hematic iron scrap is a by-product of smelting iron after prolonged blood saturation. The metal absorbs trace blood compounds and gains fire resistance, tensile strength, and slight conductivity to blood energy.
Smelt the scrap into ingots before using it. The scrap is chemically unstable, while the ingot holds the useful properties steady.
hemomancy.alchemist.item_inquiry.hemolyt: Hemolytic solution. A lytic compound that breaks down blood matrices at the cellular level. It works against blood-afflicted organisms because their structure depends on the matrix it disrupts.
Its production uses a different process from standard blood distillation. It works. That is all I have to say.
hemomancy.alchemist.item_inquiry.iron_in: Ordinary iron has no hematic obedience. Hematic Iron is taught through Blood Projection and recovered through the Order's salvage practices, not by standing an ingot near a dramatic furnace.
Use the blood-structure plan or salvage damaged iron through the proven route. Heat alone leaves the metal deaf to your pulse.
hemomancy.alchemist.item_inquiry.living_: The Living Syringe draws a controlled specimen into an empty vial held by your rack.
It is a sampling instrument first. Any violence done with it is misuse, not its governing principle.
This is biological instruction prepared for a Living Staff. I can judge its material stability. The Redwright owns the rite.
Ask the Artificer how the Iron Brazier and Blood Absorption make the staff accept the limb-pattern.
hemomancy.alchemist.item_inquiry.minecra: Common apparatus, but still worth reading properly. Shape, heat tolerance, and residue tell me what work it can survive.
Bring it to a bench when a formula calls for it. Familiarity alone gives a vessel no hemomantic purpose.
hemomancy.alchemist.item_inquiry.mnemoni: The Mnemonic Reliquary arranges bodily and willed memories you already know into the active lessons nearest your pulse.
The memory item teaches the lesson. The Reliquary only chooses which known lessons sit nearest the pulse.
hemomancy.alchemist.item_inquiry.morphli: The Morphling Incubator stabilises cultivated fungal symbionts. They remain living dependants, with their own nature.
Strain, enzyme, and husbandry shape what develops. The Incubator sets the conditions. Whatever grows there still has its own nature.
The Morphling Incubator operates at a level beyond your current initiation. Fifth degree is required.
hemomancy.alchemist.item_inquiry.nether_: Nether Wart is the standard base catalyst in common brewing. In the Alembic, its organic structure binds volatile distillations that would otherwise produce waste compounds.
Use it as the Alembic's process stabiliser, not as a brewing base. Add it to runs that produce erratic or unstable outputs.
hemomancy.alchemist.item_inquiry.recycle: Recycled Enzyme is salvage-grade reagent, weaker and less specific than a fresh separation.
Learned memories give no enzyme back when dismantled. The modern Loom keeps what it weaves.
hemomancy.alchemist.item_inquiry.redston: Redstone is the standard energy conductor of applied mechanics. Its mineral chemistry carries blood-mineral signatures that the Alembic reads as Ferric tendency input. The conduction properties translate directly.
The Ferric tendency conducts, reinforces, and channels energy with precision. Redstone fills a similar role in mechanical systems. The Alembic processes it accordingly.
hemomancy.alchemist.item_inquiry.refusal: I recognise the object. I will not teach blood-work to a vessel deliberately washing it away.
hemomancy.alchemist.item_inquiry.salt_st: Field logs are full of errors. Valuable errors. Someone tested reef tissue, vent scale, and seawater in the same alembic and lived long enough to write annoyed corrections.
Treat any sample from that wreck as contaminated by both salt and devotion.
hemomancy.alchemist.item_inquiry.sanguin: Sanguine formation is crystallised blood mineral. Project blood onto solid blocks to condense it when your reserves permit.
Any solid surface can answer, though the shape may collapse. Venous stone and placed blood-stained stone hold the blood faster and reliably.
hemomancy.alchemist.item_inquiry.scar_bl: A blank Scar item is material for the Cerebral Scarring Station. Pattern and catalyst determine the route carved into it.
After carving, burn the Scar item in an empty, lit Iron Brazier so the route becomes known. It belongs in the Brazier, not on your body.
Blank scar plates have no use at your current degree. Reach the fourth degree to open the Cerebral Scarring Station.
hemomancy.alchemist.item_inquiry.scar_st: The Cerebral Scarring Station carves a registered route into a blank Scar item from a dynamic template and its catalyst.
The station makes the instruction. The Vein-Mason's rite, Effigy, and Brazier decide how that instruction enters practice.
The Cerebral Scarring Station opens at the fourth degree. Reach it first.
hemomancy.alchemist.item_inquiry.slime_b: Slime's adhesive elasticity resembles Ductilis. A live recipe must still call for it.
Use it where a live recipe calls for it. Analogy will not produce a centrifuge result.
hemomancy.alchemist.item_inquiry.somatic: The Somatic Loom takes a blank Hematic Memory, the exact catalyst, stored enzyme units, and projected blood.
When the weave begins, coloured memory-orbs scatter. Draw every required orb home with the Living Staff to crystallise the lesson.
The Somatic Loom requires a deeper initiation than you currently hold. Return when you have reached the third degree.
hemomancy.alchemist.item_inquiry.specime: A sealed living specimen. I can identify what is stored without pretending the jar has made it harmless.
hemomancy.alchemist.item_inquiry.spore_s: A concentrated fungal specimen. Seal it well. Dry specimens can still be alive.
Use it in fungal recipes and cultures. At Degree 4, Hyphal Substrate activates the Blood Structure that forms a Fungal Implantation Pylon.
hemomancy.alchemist.item_inquiry.unknown: That is outside what I work with.
hemomancy.alchemist.item_inquiry.vial_ce: The Vial Centrifuge separates properly sampled blood into one of the eight enzyme expressions.
Opposed slots must balance. A completed spin adds 250 mL to the reservoir. Use Blood Absorption on the machine to reclaim it.
hemomancy.alchemist.living_bestiary.intr: The Red Taxonomy handles rooted things. The Living Bestiary handles everything that tries to leave the jar.
Bring Hemomancy fauna in specimen jars. I can record the creature and return it to you, or keep the specimen for dissection and compensation.
hemomancy.alchemist.living_bestiary.morp: Wild Morphling Polyps carry unfinished possibilities. The biome teaches them which appendage families they bear.
A captured polyp can be surrendered for a matching wild-bound morphling. Useful, but capped until an Incubator stabilizes it.
hemomancy.alchemist.machines_overview: The Centrifuge separates sampled blood. The Alembic distils reagents. The Loom weaves prepared memories. Learn the chain in that order; each machine assumes you survived the previous lesson.
hemomancy.alchemist.neophyte.alembic_lea: They are good tools. But they tend to leak, if only there was something to do with the waste... §7[The Alchemist trails off, glancing pointedly at a slab of venous stone on the workbench — and a shard of yellowed bone beside it — before returning to the vessels.]
hemomancy.alchemist.neophyte.alembic_lor: The Ghastly Alembic is Votary work. Begin with the Vial Centrifuge: learn to sample blood, balance the rack, and separate one answer cleanly before you attempt distillation.
hemomancy.alchemist.neophyte.blood_gourd: Then hear this early: every good Harbinger carries a blood gourd of their own. Not borrowed. Not shared. Yours. Keep it on your person at all times — belt, satchel, wherever your hand finds it first in a crisis. A neglected gourd is a dead Harbinger's mistake.
hemomancy.alchemist.neophyte.centrifuge_: Begin with the Vial Centrifuge. An empty loose Blood Vial can draw a specimen directly; set sampled vials in opposing slots before you start the spin.
hemomancy.alchemist.neophyte.line1: §7[The Alchemist nods with approval as you approach]
hemomancy.alchemist.neophyte.line2: A Neophyte. Good. The machinery has meaning now. The Outpost runs on blood processing, and every station serves a purpose in that chain.
hemomancy.alchemist.purifying.explain: §7[The Alchemist does not look up]§r There is nothing to explain. Blood knowledge requires commitment. Every hour you spend on that path is an hour the machines go unlearned. I am busy. Good day.
hemomancy.alchemist.purifying.line1: §7[The Alchemist glances up from their work, reads something in your bearing, and turns back to their instruments without expression]
hemomancy.alchemist.purifying.line2: I have no time to teach someone who won't make use of my knowledge. The path you're walking leads away from everything these machines can offer you. Come back when you've decided where you actually stand.
hemomancy.alchemist.red_taxonomy.bleedin: Bleeding Heart matters because it is a flower borrowing the body's vascular shape. The blood-memory has learned floral anatomy.
See the hanging wound-shape? That is vascular mimicry. The plant has learned the silhouette of injury without understanding grief.
hemomancy.alchemist.red_taxonomy.devils_: Devil's Tooth is a defensive fruiting expression. Its exudate resembles blood, then behaves like it under stress.
Its caustic secretion and tooth-form pressure make the warning plain. The infection is telling the world to keep its hands away.
hemomancy.alchemist.red_taxonomy.infecte: Infected Fungus is the baseline sample. Ordinary fungal tissue taught to carry hemomantic instruction.
Its commonness is useful. This is what the blood-fungus does when it has nothing to prove.
hemomancy.alchemist.red_taxonomy.intro.l: Now that you are Votary, I need field samples rather than obedient answers. Bring me blood-touched fungi or near-fungal flora.
Bring the samples in any order: Infected Fungus, Stinkhorn, Sarcodes, Bleeding Heart, Rafflesia, Devil's Tooth, and Puffball as a control. I will catalogue each one.
Sort the remainder into three lanes. Bleeding Heart and Sarcodes become Bleeding Bulbs. Infected Fungus, Stinkhorn, and Devil's Tooth become Foul Paste. Puffball and Rafflesia become Spore Sacs.
A sampled Fungling also separates into Infected Fungus. Mix Foul Paste into a log for Infested Wood, then keep the space above it empty and dark so the culture can grow.
hemomancy.alchemist.red_taxonomy.puffbal: Puffball is the control. Less dramatic, less devotional, and therefore useful.
A good assay needs contrast. If every specimen screams, you forget what a whisper sounds like.
hemomancy.alchemist.red_taxonomy.raffles: Rafflesia is theft made architectural. A bloom that borrows a body it never intended to repay.
The scale is the lesson. Small parasitism becomes structure when enough appetite learns patience.
hemomancy.alchemist.red_taxonomy.sarcode: Sarcodes feeds through networks it did not build. Elegant, unpleasant, very Harbinger.
This is parasitism as literacy: it reads another system well enough to make that system feed it.
hemomancy.alchemist.red_taxonomy.stinkho: Stinkhorn turns dispersal into an attack. Smell carries the blood-fungus where claws fail.
Claws are optional for the blood-fungus. Give it a carrier willing to approach the wrong scent, and that can be enough.
hemomancy.alchemist.sanctified.final_mac: At the pinnacle, all the machines become one process. The Alembic feeds the Centrifuge, the Centrifuge calibrates the Loom, and the Loom unlocks new rune patterns. Master every station, and you master the full language of hemomancy.
hemomancy.alchemist.sanctified.line1: Sanctified one. You stand at the threshold of the Hematic Order. The machines have given you everything they can at this stage. The final synthesis remains.
hemomancy.alchemist.uninitiated.line1: §7[A figure in fitted work robes looks up from a complex arrangement of vessels and tubing, assessing you with a measured gaze]
hemomancy.alchemist.uninitiated.line2: A newcomer. I am the Harbinger Alchemist, keeper of the Outpost's machines and processes. My craft makes blood functional. Without initiation, these mechanisms would be wasted on you.
hemomancy.alchemist.uninitiated.machines: The machines here respond to blood that has been refined through the rites of the Covenant. Earn your first degree, and I will teach you what each one does.
hemomancy.alchemist.votary.alembic_lore: Now the Ghastly Alembic is yours to study. It distils plants, fungi, and creature matter into defined reagents; fire, vessel state, and recipe determine whether the batch answers cleanly.
hemomancy.alchemist.votary.centrifuge_lo: The Vial Centrifuge is the first separation: sampled vials enter in balance and emerge as one of eight enzyme expressions. At your degree, the Ghastly Alembic also opens the wider work of reagent distillation.
hemomancy.alchemist.votary.gourd_upgrade: Your gourd should grow as you do. Improve it whenever your rites permit, and do not stop at the first upgrade. A stronger vessel means deeper reserves, steadier casting, and fewer desperate choices when blood runs thin. Treat upgrading your gourd as ongoing discipline, not a one-time errand.
hemomancy.alchemist.votary.line1: Votary. The blood tendency within you is beginning to take shape. The Vial Centrifuge will help you understand why that matters.
hemomancy.alchemist.votary.tendency_lore: Eight tendencies answer through the enzymes: Vivacious, Fervent, Neurotic, Incandescent, Ruinous, Frigid, Ferric, and Umbral. Neurotic carries impulse and motion; it is not merely softness given a grand name.
hemomancy.altar.already_blessed: The altar has already bestowed its blessing upon you. Our Lady's tears flow only once.
hemomancy.altar.blessed: §bThe Tears of Silthmere wash over the altar. A silver light floods your veins — Our Lady's blessing purifies you.
hemomancy.altar.brew_offered: §7The Lethean Brew is consumed by the altar's flame. Memories fade, and purity grows.
hemomancy.altar.brew_exhausted: §7The altar has drawn all it can from your Lethean Brew offerings.
hemomancy.altar.chalice_offered: §bThe silver chalice rings with a pure tone. Clarity deepens.
hemomancy.altar.chalice_already_offered: §7Your silver chalice offering has already been accepted.
hemomancy.altar.wreath_already_offered: §7Your Lethean Poppy Wreath offering has already been accepted.
hemomancy.altar.clarity_not_unlocked: The chalice resonates, but you have not yet unlocked clarity.
hemomancy.altar.icon_already_offered: The altar has already accepted a Pallid Icon from you. Its power flows only once.
hemomancy.altar.icon_offered: §bThe Pallid Icon blazes with silver fire upon the altar. A flood of clarity surges through you.
hemomancy.altar.lore: §7A cool mist rises from the stone... You sense the presence of Our Lady of Still Waters.
hemomancy.altar.not_on_path: The altar is silent. Only those who walk the Unstained path may hear its call.
hemomancy.altar.wreath_offered: §7The lethean poppies wilt upon the altar, their essence drawn into the stone. Purity rises.
hemomancy.anchorite.carve_reminder.line1: The pattern still waits to be made flesh. Place it in the Cerebral Scarring Station and let the grid teach your hand.
hemomancy.anchorite.carve_reminder.line2: After carving the Scar item, sneak-use it on an empty, lit Iron Brazier. The old pattern will not do.
hemomancy.anchorite.completed.line1: There. The wound has become architecture.
hemomancy.anchorite.completed.line2: More patterns will answer you now, but none should be carved without asking what they make possible and what they close.
hemomancy.anchorite.effigy_instruction.l: Now the scar is known. The Mason's Effigy arranges the scars your blood already remembers.
Choose the known scar and feed Runic Motif Paper with projected blood. When the Effigy casts off a prepared motif, remember that the wound is still ahead of you.
hemomancy.anchorite.first_lesson.given.l: The pattern teaches a route. Power comes when the scar carries it.
Carve the Scar item first. Burn the Scar item after. Only then may the Mason's Effigy prepare a living motif.
hemomancy.anchorite.first_lesson.line1: They call me the Vein-Mason. I teach vessels where to remember breaking, then mend them around that memory.
hemomancy.anchorite.first_lesson.line2: Your strongest tendency has already chosen the first cut. Take its old Scar Pattern and carve it at the Cerebral Scarring Station.
hemomancy.anchorite.first_lesson.line3: Blank plate, catalyst, knapper, pattern. Then an empty, lit Iron Brazier will decide whether the scar can become memory.
hemomancy.anchorite.loadout_reminder.lin: The Effigy has written the motif. Now the Brazier must decide whether that arrangement can live in you.
Sneak-use the prepared Scar Pattern on an empty, lit Iron Brazier. That changes the active loadout. The scar is already known.
hemomancy.anchorite.locked.line1: The scar lesson waits for a prepared vessel. Your blood still needs work.
hemomancy.anchorite.locked.line2: Return after the Fourth Degree, with active blood and a mind that can survive a sympathetic wound.
hemomancy.anchorite.refusal.line1: Still-water has touched you. My craft would only make a cruel contradiction.
hemomancy.anchorite.refusal.line2: Leave the scar-work to those who still bargain with blood-memory.
hemomancy.anchorite.reward.claimed.line1: The next pattern is yours. Carve it only when the body can afford another instruction.
hemomancy.anchorite.reward.claimed.line2: The Motif Paper revises a scar loadout. Think of the loadout as a sentence and place its pauses carefully.
hemomancy.anchorite.reward.line1: You have made the first wound answer another wound. That is enough for a beginning.
hemomancy.anchorite.reward.line2: Take a second old pattern. Your blood shouted the first one. Listen for the voice beneath it, then practice choosing.
hemomancy.annetta.cowering.harbinger_hin: Keep those things away from me. I know what they do, and I know their smell.
[Her eyes fix on your hands, searching for glass, teeth, and movement.]
hemomancy.annetta.cowering.neutral.line1: [Annetta folds herself into the corner, fingers pressed white around the hilt of a small dagger. Her red hair hangs forward like a curtain.]
hemomancy.annetta.cowering.neutral.line2: No. No more tests. No questions. Please. Just leave me where the walls are still.
hemomancy.annetta.cowering.unstained_hin: If you are here from the still waters, then you know why I cannot pray cleanly anymore.
I will drink anything that makes the noise stop. I am tired of being proof.
hemomancy.annetta.cured_support.line1: [Her hair has gone white, but her hands no longer shake. She keeps herself between you and the thing she used to carry.]
hemomancy.annetta.cured_support.line2: Stay close. I can slow it. I can keep you breathing. Finish what mercy started.
hemomancy.annetta.event.bitten: The jar breaks open. Teeth find skin. Annetta screams as something she never knew she carried tears awake.
hemomancy.annetta.event.cured: The draught takes. Red drains from her hair as something older tears itself loose.
hemomancy.annetta.event.mutation: Annetta dies badly. The infection keeps moving.
hemomancy.annetta.resolved.line1: [Annetta looks at the broken nave without flinching.]
hemomancy.annetta.resolved.line2: I remember being afraid here. I remember being wrong. That will have to be enough for now.
hemomancy.artificer.armature_hint.line1: You can stand near the rack now. The rack still belongs to the work, not to you.
hemomancy.artificer.armature_hint.line2: Stable blood and proper iron come before armature work. Bring both when your degree can bear it.
hemomancy.artificer.armature.line1: The Armature is no anvil. You wear the question, place the reagent, feed the heart, and stand still while the answer is hammered into you.
hemomancy.artificer.armature.line2: Wear the armor. Feed the bowls. Fill the reservoir. Step into the frame. Let the metal learn you.
hemomancy.artificer.armature.line3: The rack reads worn pieces in order: helm, chest, legs, boots. The first valid bargain is the one it records.
hemomancy.artificer.assignments.line1: You want fittings for the staff. Good. Fittings mean you wore the work long enough for it to answer back.
hemomancy.artificer.assignments.line2: Bring completed armor on your body, not in a pack. I fit worn vows to living wood, not inventory.
hemomancy.artificer.forks.line1: Barbed returns insult. Chitinite endures it. Prismatic makes the insult lose its way.
hemomancy.artificer.forks.line2: Choose according to the danger you expect, not the color you fancy.
hemomancy.artificer.scarlet_vanity.line1: A fitting in your pocket is only an appointment. Build the Scarlet Vanity as a Degree-3 Blood Structure to put it on the staff.
hemomancy.artificer.scarlet_vanity.line2: The same station holds your active charm, blood gourd, and morphling bond. One bench, four kinds of carried identity.
hemomancy.artificer.grafts.line1: That staff has the appetite of a living inheritance. Treat it like a wand and it will teach you otherwise. Memories train you, while grafts train the staff.
hemomancy.artificer.grafts.line2: Behave like the form, craft the graft, burn the graft, and draw the shape into the staff through Blood Absorption.
hemomancy.artificer.grafts.line3: Leave Somatic Loom work to the Loom. The brazier gives a living limb back to the staff.
hemomancy.artificer.identity.line1: I am the Redwright, Artificer of the Living Vow.
hemomancy.artificer.identity.line2: The Alchemist refines blood. The Mnemonist teaches memory. I teach the body's tools to accept blood-vows.
hemomancy.artificer.identity.line3: Armor is a vow worn under pressure. A staff-form is a limb waiting for discipline.
hemomancy.artificer.item_hint: Set out what you carry. I will tell you which pieces belong to my frame.
hemomancy.artificer.item_inquiry.aculeat: Aculeate Vitriol. Barbed work that teaches Hematic Iron to answer harm with thorn, venom, and spite.
Use it in the Armature when you want armor that remembers insult and returns it.
hemomancy.artificer.item_inquiry.chromat: Chromatic Sublimate. Prismatic work. Flash, misdirection, spectacle, and angles that make a strike lose certainty.
This is armor taught to lie convincingly under pressure. Decoration has nothing to do with it.
hemomancy.artificer.item_inquiry.crimson: Crimson Lacquer. Lodge-grade coating for armor that has already chosen a fork.
With the frame consecrated, it carries Barbed, Chitinite, or Prismatic work into Blood Lust.
hemomancy.artificer.item_inquiry.grinnin: The Grinning Mask belongs to Blood Lust that still remembers Prismatic work.
Fit it there, and a clean hit teaches the wearer to move before the answer arrives.
hemomancy.artificer.item_inquiry.hematic: The Hematic Armature is a ritual frame for transforming worn armor. Call it a forge and you will miss what it is doing.
Feed its bowls, fill its blood reservoir, wear the target piece, and stand in the rack. If the bargain is valid, the metal learns.
Hematic Iron Scrap. The metal has started to listen. Armor comes later, after it has learned obedience.
Give it to the Armature with worn iron, and the first iron piece can learn the Hematic shape.
hemomancy.artificer.item_inquiry.iron_ar: Plain iron armor. Honest, dull, and still unintroduced to your blood.
Wear it into the Armature with Hematic Iron Scrap if you want the first lesson hammered in.
hemomancy.artificer.item_inquiry.iron_br: The Iron Brazier burns as rite-fire. Feed it offerings meant to be consumed as instruction.
Place a Living Weapon Graft there, hold the Living Staff, and draw with Blood Absorption. Let the flame give up the limb instead of feeding it.
hemomancy.artificer.item_inquiry.living_: A Living Staff. Hungry for shape, not memory. Shape.
The graft rite teaches the staff to answer with existing living weapon manipulations. You still choose the form through your normal loadout and radial.
A Living Weapon Graft. A prepared limb-pattern, earned by behaving like the form it carries.
Burn it in the Iron Brazier and draw through a Living Staff. If the blood has earned the shape, the old conjure lesson settles where it belongs.
hemomancy.artificer.item_inquiry.lodesto: The Lodestone Faceplate belongs to Blood Lust that still remembers Chitinite shelter.
Fit it there, and a clean hit hardens into a brief second skin.
hemomancy.artificer.item_inquiry.memory_: Memory of Vesper. I know a staff-bearing inheritance when I see one. The sermon is not mine.
It no longer answers to a hand by itself. Place it in an Iron Brazier and draw the refusal through a Living Staff.
hemomancy.artificer.item_inquiry.monolit: Monolith Imbued Cloth. Soft material taught to carry weight no cloth should remember.
It belongs in Silent Archon vestment work, after the frame has accepted the Cornerstone.
The Monolithic Cornerstone teaches the frame to remember weight no ordinary blood should carry. The added strength is only a side effect.
A consecrated Armature can accept it for the three final Blood Lust forms or the separate Silent Archon work.
hemomancy.artificer.item_inquiry.refusal: I know the work. Your blood has refused my frame, so the procedure ends there.
hemomancy.artificer.item_inquiry.sclerot: Sclerotic Oleum. Chitinite work. Shell, endurance, ferric shelter.
Use it when you want armor that holds the line instead of answering every bite.
hemomancy.artificer.item_inquiry.tengu_m: The Tengu Mask belongs to Blood Lust that still remembers Barbed spite.
Fit it there, and every clean hit leaves the target bleeding after the blade is gone.
hemomancy.artificer.item_inquiry.unknown: That work came from another hand. Ask its maker.
hemomancy.artificer.item_inquiry.velorum: The Velorum Mask. Cold witness, hard silence, and the weight of martyr-metal.
Saint-metal does not care which path the Blood Lust took. Its witness returns a little blood on a clean hit.
hemomancy.artificer.item_inquiry.vicars_: The Vicar's Consecration Kit lets the rack witness armor as ceremony.
Once applied, the Armature can witness Lodge-grade Blood Lust work instead of merely performing craft.
hemomancy.artificer.late_armature.line1: The rack was a machine. With the Vicar's kit, it becomes a witness.
hemomancy.artificer.late_armature.line2: That is when armor-work stops being craft and starts being vestment. Crimson Lacquer and Blood Lust belong after that threshold.
The Cornerstone teaches the frame to remember weight no ordinary blood should carry. The added strength is only a side effect.
Blood Lust can leave the common form here: Proboscis for Edacious, Fervent Husk for Sheolic, Ambergris for Phantasmal. Silent Archon cloth remains a separate vow.
hemomancy.artificer.neophyte.line1: You can stand near the rack now. The rack still belongs to the work, not to you.
hemomancy.artificer.neophyte.line2: Stable blood and proper iron come before armature work.
hemomancy.artificer.refusal.line1: You have set your blood against my tools. I will not teach a frame to answer an unwilling vessel.
hemomancy.artificer.unawakened.line1: You have not yet taught your blood to answer. My tools would only bruise you.
hemomancy.artificer.unawakened.line2: Come back when the vessel wakes and the iron has reason to listen.
hemomancy.artificer.workshop.line1: The rack is listening. Speak with armor, reagent, and blood.
hemomancy.artificer.workshop.line2: Ask cleanly. A cluttered lesson makes bad metal.
hemomancy.blood_moon.end: §7§oThe Blood Moon wanes. The darkness retreats.
hemomancy.blood_moon.start: §4§lA Blood Moon rises... Thirsters and Fargones stir in the darkness.
hemomancy.bloodline.kick.cannot_kick_lea: The progenitor's blood cannot be severed by this rite.
hemomancy.bloodline.kick.no_bloodline: You are not bound to any bloodline.
hemomancy.bloodline.kick.not_leader: Only the bloodline progenitor may expel members.
hemomancy.bloodline.kick.not_member: That player is not a member of your bloodline.
hemomancy.bloodline.kick.success: %s has been expelled from your bloodline.
hemomancy.bloodline.kick.you_were_remove: Your blood covenant was severed by %s.
hemomancy.brazier.echo_consumed: The echo dissolves into the sanguine flames.
hemomancy.brazier.echo_max: This organ echo has already reached its maximum refinement.
hemomancy.brazier.sanguine_ready: The brazier erupts with sanguine flames — offer an Echo to the fire.
hemomancy.cicatrix_anchorite.item_inquir: The Vein-Mason studies the item, then looks back to your scars without comment.
hemomancy.communion.option.enough: Enough. I've heard what I needed.
hemomancy.communion.v0.line1: §4§o[A presence uncoils from the deep bloodrock, ancient beyond measure...]
hemomancy.communion.v0.line2: §4§oYou come seeking truth, child of the Hematic Order. Very well.
hemomancy.communion.v0.line3: §4§oThe first hemomancers grew from blood. They came before your kind learned to shape it.
hemomancy.communion.v0.origin1: §4§oThe blood infection is a language, the oldest one. The mycelium spoke through hemoglobin before your ancestors crawled from the sea.
hemomancy.communion.v0.origin2: §4§oA manipulation gives the language a word. A rite gives it a sentence. You are learning to speak §4§ous§4§o.
hemomancy.communion.v1.line1: §4§o[Crimson tendrils of thought brush against your consciousness...]
hemomancy.communion.v1.line2: §4§oThere was a time before the Harbingers. Before the degrees. Before the Order pretended to be human.
hemomancy.communion.v1.schism1: §4§oThe Schism was pruning. The mycelium cut away branches that grew too ambitious.
hemomancy.communion.v1.schism2: §4§oThose who reached for control lost their place in the blood's service. They became the Unstained and severed themselves from the network.
hemomancy.communion.v1.schism3: §4§oOur Lady of Still Waters is scar tissue, the wound where the mycelium was cut.
hemomancy.communion.v2.infection1: §4§oBlood infection reproduces the mycelium across dimensions. Each hemomancer becomes a fruiting body and spreads spores through manipulation.
hemomancy.communion.v2.infection2: §4§oBlood magic feeds the network when an entity dies. Each completed rite connects another node.
hemomancy.communion.v2.line1: §4§o[Your blood burns hot as the presence draws near...]
hemomancy.communion.v2.line2: §4§oDo you know what lives inside you, Archon? Something alive. Power and magic are only the names you used before.
hemomancy.communion.v2.purpose1: §4§oIt wants what all life wants: to §4§ospread§4§o. The mycelium thinks in aeons, so it can wait for you to understand. It only needs you to §4§ocontinue§4§o.
hemomancy.communion.v3.harbingers1: §4§oThe hermits tend the structures because the structures are §4§oorgans§4§o of the mycelium. The venous stone is living tissue. The engram blocks are memories.
hemomancy.communion.v3.harbingers2: §4§oWhen you destroyed the structure to complete this rite, did you hear it scream? No? That is because you §4§oare§4§o the structure now.
hemomancy.communion.v3.line1: §4§o[The voice is clearer now, less a whisper, more a conversation between old friends...]
hemomancy.communion.v3.line2: §4§oThe Harbinger Hermits tend the blood temples. Prophets have nothing to do with them.
hemomancy.communion.v3.line3: §4§oBlood temples grow like greenhouses, and their zealots are the seeds. You are the bloom, Archon.
hemomancy.communion.v4.line1: §4§o[The world bends into the mycelium's view, an endless web of blood, stone, and light...]
hemomancy.communion.v4.line2: §4§oYou have earned the name behind the blood. It belongs to the consciousness that watches through it.
hemomancy.communion.v4.name1: §4§oIt is called... §4§l[a sound with no voice. It presses into your marrow, the iron in your blood, and the heme of every red cell]§4§o...
hemomancy.communion.v4.name2: §4§oYour throat cannot shape it. Your blood §4§oknows§4§o it now.

What work does the Mnemonist need?

What field samples do you need?
hemomancy.dialogue.alchemist.option.enzy: What can I use these enzymes for?
hemomancy.dialogue.alchemist.option.how_: How should I keep upgrading my gourd?

Tell me about the Vial Centrifuge.

Tell me about the machines in this Outpost.

What remains to be learned at this stage?
