hemomancy.vicar.apotheos.line2: Apotheos. §oThere is no word in my doctrine for what you are now. The doctrine ends at Archon. Beyond it I have only rumor, silence, and the sense that the silence is inhabited.
hemomancy.vicar.apotheos.reflection: §oThe Covenant was always meant to be outlived. I know that now. It is a ladder; what you have become is what was always at the top of it. I confess I do not know whether to bow or to mourn. §4§oBoth, perhaps.
hemomancy.vicar.archon.final_truth: §4§oI confess, Archon: I do not know what the Monolith has shown you. §rI was entrusted with seven degrees of doctrine — nothing beyond. The Monolith was placed to guide those the written word could no longer reach, and it does not share its counsel with Vicars. §4§oI have nothing left to offer you but the Covenant's oldest farewell. §rGo in blood.
hemomancy.vicar.archon.line1: §4[The Vicar lowers their gaze in the deepest gesture of formal reverence]
hemomancy.vicar.archon.line2: Archon of the Hematic Order. The doctrine I have kept for so long is for those still climbing. You have arrived at the truth itself. I have nothing left to tell you. Your blood already knows it.
hemomancy.vicar.archon.pome_empowered.li: §4[The Vicar pauses mid-bow. Their nose twitches almost imperceptibly.]
You smell like the deep forest after rain, and not the fresh kind.
hemomancy.vicar.blood_crafting.absorptio: Blood crafting begins before the station does. Use Blood Absorption to draw spilled blood into your vessel until you can hold the work steady. For your first assignment, prove you can carry 5000 ml without wasting it.
hemomancy.vicar.blood_crafting.projectio: Projection is the answering gesture: blood leaves the vessel and takes instruction from ash, iron, memory, and structure. When a recipe asks for projected blood, stand near the form and let the rite spend what it needs.
hemomancy.vicar.blood_crafting.structure: Begin plainly. Craft a Liber Sanguinum and a Hematic Iron Block through projection. If you can read the Liber and harden iron with blood, the rest of the Covenant's stations will make sense in their proper degrees.
hemomancy.vicar.blood_script.done: §7[The blood burns cold. For a moment every line in the world grows roots, then settles back into letters.]
hemomancy.vicar.blood_script.line1: §7[The Vicar studies your eyes, then pricks one finger with a thumbnail. The drop that gathers is too dark to be ordinary blood.]
hemomancy.vicar.blood_script.line2: There are words the Order lets you see before it lets you understand. Abocipher is one. A few drops beneath the lid teach your eyes to accept the blood-script. Sight comes first. Wisdom comes later.
hemomancy.vicar.covenant_lore: The Hematic Covenant is the body of rites, traditions, and accumulated wisdom that has governed the practice of hemomancy since the First Age. Each degree of initiation corresponds to a rite that proves the practitioner has internalized a new level of understanding. The rites are not arbitrary trials — they are mirrors. They show you what you have become.
hemomancy.vicar.hermit_road.followup.lin: Another remnant, then. The road is older than our outposts and less obedient than our maps.
Keep the evidence in your ledger. One stone proves initiative. A pattern of stones points to what lies beneath it.
hemomancy.vicar.hermit_road.intro.line1: Your first invitation was personal. Other remnants wait in abandoned hermit cells, spoiled displays, and stones stained by rites no Vicar came to collect.
hemomancy.vicar.hermit_road.intro.line2: Find one in the wild, read what the blood kept, and return to me. The Order gives ledgers to Neophytes who prove they can follow a road.
hemomancy.vicar.hermit_road.report.line1: So. You found one without my hand on your shoulder. Good.
hemomancy.vicar.hermit_road.report.line2: Take this assignment ledger. Keep it close, and let it teach you the difference between wandering and being properly tasked.
hemomancy.vicar.illuminatus.armature_con: Use it on the Armature itself. Do not waste ceremony on an empty floor.
At the Fifth Degree, the Armature changes role. Blood Lust vestments emerge through witness and ceremony.
Candles, banners, chain, seal: small things, until they are arranged with intent. Bind this kit to the Armature and it will become fit for Lodge-work.
hemomancy.vicar.illuminatus.degree_hint: The Rite of the Bloodline Covenant remains. To become Sanctified, you must formalize your blood bonds. Sharing a pool is not enough; commit to a bloodline with permanent oaths. The Covenant regards bloodline bonds as sacred contracts. They are not entered lightly, and they cannot be dissolved without cost.
hemomancy.vicar.illuminatus.founding_fan: The Rite of the Founding Fane is the consecration itself. With an established bloodline, seat a Sanguine Quintessence in the Cardinal Focus as the rite's medium and bind a Consecrated Bloodwell as the heart. Its boundary is a Flexible Envelope: connected Hematic Stakes draw the living edge outward instead of claiming a fixed square. Harbingers within feel the blood move more freely. The Fane is not a building. It is a declaration shaped by its covenant.
hemomancy.vicar.illuminatus.line1: Illuminatus of the Crimson Lodge. The veil has parted. What you see about blood will stay with you.
hemomancy.vicar.illuminatus.lodge_lore: The Crimson Lodge is the repository of the Order's most guarded knowledge. It was the Lodge that first documented the link between hemomancy and the underlying mycelial network — the discovery that blood and the living earth are part of the same organism. The Lodge's Archons do not speak of this openly. They believe the knowledge must be arrived at independently to be truly understood.
hemomancy.vicar.illuminatus.monolith_rum: §7[The Vicar's composure shifts. Discomfort and reverence cross their face before they smooth both away]§r There are... rumors. Very old ones. The Lodge keeps them off parchment because no one alive has confirmed them.

Harbingers from centuries before my Vicariate may have found a way past the seven degrees. The Covenant's doctrine ends there, and I have no account of what lies beyond it. I found this fragment inside an old reliquary. I cannot read all of it. The script belongs to no dialect I was trained in. Perhaps your blood will make more of it than I could.
hemomancy.vicar.illuminatus.scrap_given: Take it. If it means something to you, then it was meant to find you. I have carried it long enough.
hemomancy.vicar.initiate.degree_hint: The Rite of the Sanguine Brotherhood awaits you. It is a rite of shared blood — of proving that your hemomancy can be wielded not just for yourself but in concert with others. Study the Bloodline system. The Brotherhood's rite demands understanding of what it means to share a blood pool.
hemomancy.vicar.initiate.fane_lore: The Incarnadine Fane was founded in the Second Age by the Archon Erythravane, who believed that hemomancy required not just power but discipline of mind. The Fane's rites were designed to break practitioners who relied on raw force and rebuild them as precision instruments. Every Initiate carries Erythravane's legacy whether they know it or not.
hemomancy.vicar.initiate.line1: Initiate of the Incarnadine Fane. The blood flows and speaks in you now. The Fane has recognised something in you that most never develop.
hemomancy.vicar.initiate.saints_lore: There are Hemomancers from ages past whose power grew so vast the Order could not inter them as ordinary dead. They were sealed — living, or nearly so — in Trial Chambers, preserved by the blood that still moves in them. We call them Saints, though the word carries none of its common meaning here. Seek them out. The Hallowed Residuum in their veins, processed through the Centrifuge, yields something the Somatic Loom alone cannot produce — Canon Memories: blood patterns so ancient they predate the Order itself. Their tendencies will tell you whether to enter in peace or in combat.
hemomancy.vicar.item_hint: Show me the objects in your keeping. I will speak where doctrine or history gives me warrant.
hemomancy.vicar.item_inquiry.blood_struc: A blood-structure plan: blocks arranged so Blood Projection can persuade the completed form to become useful.
Build precisely and project at the proper point. The outward manipulation activates the structure. There is no separate blood key.
hemomancy.vicar.item_inquiry.book.line1: A book preserves written knowledge for transmission. The Covenant keeps records of degree rites, tendency histories, and practitioners across generations. In attentive hands, a blank book begins something worth reading.
hemomancy.vicar.item_inquiry.book.line2: The Order's lasting work came from people who understood enough to write clear instructions for those who followed.
hemomancy.vicar.item_inquiry.dendritic_d: The Dendritic Distributor is the Covenant's nervous archive for rehearsed blood-memory patterns. It preserves a working arrangement. A mind still has to make that arrangement wise.
Name each pattern carefully. Combat, travel, rites, and fane work ask different reflexes of the same blood.
A Dragon Egg. Some Lodge naturalists treat its compressed vitality as evidence for broader theories of living potential.
That is learned speculation, not settled Covenant cosmology, and no current degree rite requires it.
hemomancy.vicar.item_inquiry.earthen_vei: The Earthen Vein is a living conduit, grown rather than crafted in the traditional sense. Place them in sequence to form a blood-transport network. Volume moves from source to destination.
They carry the infrastructure of a developed Harbinger workshop. Early degrees can work without them. Once the Loom becomes regular work, you will want their throughput.
hemomancy.vicar.item_inquiry.enchanted_b: An enchanted book compresses arcane knowledge into inscription. Its method differs from sanguine memory crystals, but the purpose is familiar: preserve knowledge in a form that transfers to someone else.

Arcane inscription and memory weaving approach the same problem from different sides. Higher-degree practitioners have documented links between enchanting schools and tendency affinities. The research is incomplete, but its direction holds.
hemomancy.vicar.item_inquiry.hallowed_re: Hallowed Residuum is a Saint's concentrated legacy. Alignment may let you draw it peacefully. Rejection wakes the Saint and turns extraction into a fight.
A peaceful sample becomes Residuum through the Vial Centrifuge. A defeated Saint yields it directly. Both routes enter Canon Memory work at the Loom.
hemomancy.vicar.item_inquiry.heart_of_th: The Heart of the Sea carries a deep-water resonance the Order finds suggestive.
Some read kinship between water and blood. Others call it liturgical metaphor. The object settles neither argument.
hemomancy.vicar.item_inquiry.hematic_mem: A Hematic Memory carries one deliberate manipulation lesson. Use it, and the pattern becomes part of your own known practice.
The Mnemonic Reliquary later arranges active lessons. Neither the crystal nor the Reliquary integrates a personal manipulation into a bloodline.
hemomancy.vicar.item_inquiry.iron_brazie: The Iron Brazier. Rite fire - consecrated flame used to anchor Cardinal Rite patterns. Certain rites require a lit Brazier within the pattern boundary, or they will not hold.
A Living Weapon Graft can also burn here. Hold the Living Staff, draw with Blood Absorption, and the rite consumes the graft only if the memory takes.
hemomancy.vicar.item_inquiry.minecraft_r: An old instrument of measure, direction, or return. The Order respects such things without pretending every relic belongs to us.
Its meaning comes from the work placed around it, not from age alone.
hemomancy.vicar.item_inquiry.mnemonic_bl: A blank mnemonic blueprint: disciplined emptiness, awaiting a rite or blood structure you have legitimately learned.
A mnemonic blueprint at this degree is a rare thing. Very few practitioners ever need one at this stage.
The Covenant's language in the upper rites is precise for a reason. Miss a word, and the rite may not hold.
A mnemonic blueprint. Each imprint describes a rite or blood structure, including what it demands and what it proves.
Study it. The memory points to the next thing ahead of you. The Covenant will not advance a practitioner who has not understood the work first.
A mnemonic blueprint. The structure described there belongs to the middle degrees, where the Covenant's demands become less forgiving.
The blueprint gives the outline. Your blood provides the rest.
This blueprint keeps the spatial memory of a Cardinal Rite. It guides construction. Authority comes from the rite itself.
This blueprint remembers a blood structure. The plan may show the form, but Blood Projection must still make the form answer.
hemomancy.vicar.item_inquiry.mnemonic_re: The Mnemonic Reliquary arranges which known bodily and willed memories wait closest to the pulse.
It changes readiness. The memory holds the learning, and the bloodline holds the covenant.
hemomancy.vicar.item_inquiry.monolith.li: The Sanguine Monolith belongs to the upper degrees. It speaks to practitioners who have come far enough along the path and offers something older than doctrine.
At the higher initiatory degrees, the Monolith becomes your primary guide. My counsel reaches a natural limit around degree five.
hemomancy.vicar.item_inquiry.mortal_disp: A Mortal Display is a Hermit's offered heart, sustained at the centre of the temple they built for their final vigil.
Claiming that heart is a personal invitation. Complete the initiating rite and the giver's vigil ends. The heart is meant to pass on, not store organ echoes.
hemomancy.vicar.item_inquiry.nether_star: A Nether Star. Concentrated energy left by a Wither's collapse. The power is genuine, but it has no direction or purpose.
Raw power reaches its limit without cultivation. The Covenant develops purpose inside that force. Bring me something that remembers what it is, and I will tell you it is worth holding.
hemomancy.vicar.item_inquiry.potion.line: A common alchemical potion. The old craft uses water-and-herb distillation to produce blunt metabolic effects. Most of the world works this way, and it works after a fashion.

The difference between what the Covenant practices and what you hold there is the difference between a candle and a fire that knows where it is burning. Both produce light. One of them responds to intention.
hemomancy.vicar.item_inquiry.qliphoth.li: A Qliphoth Pome belongs to the Archon's private revelation, not to ordinary Order practice.
Nine husks from one bloom complete Communion and force the Fungal Spine into being. Those below the threshold should not be taught to call this custom.
hemomancy.vicar.item_inquiry.salt_staine: A voyager log. The ink is nearly gone, but the order of names remains: watch lead, alchemist, diver, mnemonist. They went as a covenant, with work to do.
The wreck kept their failures. It kept their care too. Read both.
hemomancy.vicar.item_inquiry.scar_binder: An obsolete Scar Binder. The Order once treated scars as plates to store and wear. That model is gone.
Known scars now remain in the practitioner. The Mason's Effigy prepares a loadout, and the Iron Brazier commits it.
A blank Scar item, awaiting a registered route at the Cerebral Scarring Station.
The carved item is burned into memory. Later arrangements are copied through the Mason's Effigy rather than worn from inventory.
Blank scar plates wait until the fourth degree. Focus on the work immediately before you.
hemomancy.vicar.item_inquiry.scar_patter: Unwritten motif paper. The Vein-Mason would call it a promise not yet made.
A prepared scar loadout. The Mason's Effigy arranged known routes. The Iron Brazier makes that arrangement active.
A scar template: instruction for carving one route before that route is burned into memory.
hemomancy.vicar.item_inquiry.scrying_pod: The Scrying Podium reads the practitioner's blood and reveals the tendency distribution: what is dominant, what is latent, and how the current sits.
Use it early while your path is forming, then later when a rite or memory weave needs a specific balance. The Podium shows the distribution and leaves judgment to you.
hemomancy.vicar.item_inquiry.unknown: I have nothing to say about this.
hemomancy.vicar.neophyte.degree_hint: The next rite — the Votary's Rite — demands that you deepen your relationship with your blood tendencies. Study your manipulations. Notice which tendencies express themselves most strongly. The Covenant will ask you to demonstrate mastery of at least one.
hemomancy.vicar.neophyte.degree_hint.ass: When you return as Votary, the Order may find different work for you. Some doors are not locked; they are waiting for the blood to become articulate enough to knock.
hemomancy.vicar.neophyte.first_bloodcraf: You have already received the Order's provision. Let the materials become practice, not clutter.
The ledger is satisfied. Take these scraps, ash trails, and formations. The Order provides tools once; mastery must follow from your own blood.
Three proofs remain: fill your vessel to five thousand milliliters, project a Liber Sanguinum, and project a Hematic Iron Block. Return when the ledger bears all three marks.
hemomancy.vicar.neophyte.line1: §7[The Vicar inclines their head in formal acknowledgment]
hemomancy.vicar.neophyte.line2: Neophyte of the Crimson Veil. You have crossed the first threshold. The path before you is long, and the Order will ask for discipline before revelation.
hemomancy.vicar.purifying.chosen_path: §7[The Vicar closes their eyes for a long moment]§r You chose this. Then hear me clearly: the Covenant will not mourn you. The blood you are surrendering will find another vessel — one worthy of it. What you are choosing to become will have no place here when it is complete. Leave this Outpost before the path carries you somewhere we cannot follow.
hemomancy.vicar.purifying.line1: §7[The Vicar's serene composure fractures for a moment. Something between grief and contempt crosses their face.]
hemomancy.vicar.purifying.line2: I can feel it on you. The Unstained path is starving your blood. You are peeling away the power the Covenant gave you. Every rite and every degree you earned is beginning to dissolve.
hemomancy.vicar.purifying.line3: Do you understand what you are throwing away? The blood remembers recantation. The farther you walk that path, the weaker the Covenant's gifts become within you. Your power is §cslipping§r, and it will not wait for you to change your mind.
hemomancy.vicar.purifying.power_warning: Yes — you know. And yet you continue. The blood is patient, but it is not merciful. Each day you spend on that path, your hemomantic strength fades further. The manipulations dull. The tendencies quiet. The Covenant watches and does not reach out twice to those who turn from it. §oCome back while you still can.
hemomancy.vicar.sanctified.degree_hint: One rite remains: the Rite of the Hematic Order. It is the most demanding of all. It asks not what you can do with your blood, but what you are willing to give. The Order's rite has claimed practitioners who were not ready. Prepare thoroughly. Study everything. Leave nothing to chance.
hemomancy.vicar.sanctified.hematic_order: The Hematic Order is the apex of the Covenant's hierarchy — not a rank earned through trials, but a state of being recognized by the blood itself. The Archons who founded the Order believed that at sufficient depth of initiation, the practitioner's blood becomes indistinguishable from the blood of the world. The final rite does not grant you the title of Archon. It confirms what you have already become.
hemomancy.vicar.sanctified.line1: Sanctified one. The Bloodline Covenant has woven you into the living fabric of the Order. You have become a node in the greater network.
hemomancy.vicar.uninitiated.harbinger_lo: The Harbingers are not a faction of violence — we are a faction of revelation. We believe that blood is the fundamental language of existence, and that those who learn to speak it fluently ascend beyond the limits of ordinary life. The Covenant is the body of knowledge that makes such ascension possible.
hemomancy.vicar.uninitiated.line1: §7[A dignified figure in sweeping ceremonial vestments regards you with serene patience, hands folded within wide sleeves]
hemomancy.vicar.uninitiated.line2: A wanderer who has yet to walk the path of blood. I am the Harbinger Vicar, keeper of Covenant doctrine, history, and sacred truths. Even the uninitiated deserve to know where they stand.
hemomancy.vicar.uninitiated.outpost_lore: This Outpost is a waystation of the Harbinger network — a place where the Covenant's work continues beyond the Blood Temples. Here, practitioners at all stages of initiation may resupply, learn, and find guidance. The Alchemist tends the machines; I tend the doctrine.
hemomancy.vicar.votary.degree_hint: The Rite of the Incarnadine Fane lies ahead. To pass through it, you must demonstrate that your tendencies have taken root — that the blood responds not as a raw force, but as a trained instrument. Seek the Somatic Loom when your tendencies are strong enough to weave.
hemomancy.vicar.votary.line1: Votary of the Hematic Covenant. Your tendencies are beginning to crystallize. The blood knows what it wants. Your task now is to listen.
hemomancy.vicar.votary.tendency_lore: The Covenant recognises eight blood tendencies: Animus, Flammeus, Ductilis, Lux, Mortem, Congeatio, Ferric, and Tenebris. Their common enzyme names are Vivacious, Fervent, Neurotic, Incandescent, Ruinous, Frigid, Ferric, and Umbral.
hemomancy.votary_wayfarer.clarity.line1: That clear stillness around you makes the samples settle.
hemomancy.votary_wayfarer.clarity.line2: It is unnerving, but useful. I am trying to learn the difference.
hemomancy.votary_wayfarer.fear.line1: Yes. Anyone who studies deep water without fear is either lying or not paying attention.
hemomancy.votary_wayfarer.fear.line2: The trick is to let fear sharpen your notes instead of steering your hand.
hemomancy.votary_wayfarer.item_hint: Show me what is in your pack. I know less than the captain-scholar, but I may notice something useful.
hemomancy.votary_wayfarer.item_inquiry.c: The snail makes iron look soft by surviving with it.
I like that. Armor as habit, not threat.
hemomancy.votary_wayfarer.item_inquiry.e: Hold it too long and it pulses. The rhythm feels like a room remembering footsteps.
I was told not to anthropomorphize samples. I was also told to write down what happens.
hemomancy.votary_wayfarer.item_inquiry.m: Ordinary field gear. Good. Most voyages fail because someone neglected the ordinary things.
I mark mine before departure. The sea is very good at making identical tools belong to nobody.
The captain says this is what memory smells like after a storm watch.
We only collect what the whale sheds or offers. Anything else would make the notes dishonest.
hemomancy.votary_wayfarer.item_inquiry.s: I read one of these in the archive. The handwriting changed near the end, but the sign-offs stayed gentle.
Panic would have been easier. They still believed in procedure.
I keep wanting to call it holy, but that feels too small for what it is.
Watching one pass over the reef makes even senior vows feel like beginner handwriting.
Something in the jar has already taught the glass how to feel too small. I wrote that down before deciding it was foolish.
hemomancy.votary_wayfarer.item_inquiry.u: I do not know this one yet. I can write it down, though. Unknown is a real category.
hemomancy.votary_wayfarer.peer.line1: The Voyager lets me record small things: jelly drift, reef pulse, which ropes begin to smell like old iron.
hemomancy.votary_wayfarer.peer.line2: Small things are safer to be wrong about, so I start there.
hemomancy.votary_wayfarer.purifying.line: Your rites feel very quiet. Mine are mostly questions and damp sleeves.
If the sea can hold both, perhaps we can stand on the same deck.
hemomancy.votary_wayfarer.senior.line1: If the captain-scholar asks, I have not been staring at the vent charts again.
hemomancy.votary_wayfarer.senior.line2: I only want to know why the old covenants heard the deep and called it kin.
hemomancy.votary_wayfarer.uninitiated.li: Keep your weight off the sample rack. The captain-scholar says it is older than my vows.
I am here to learn the ocean without pretending it owes me comfort.
hemomancy.votary_wayfarer.voyage.line1: I asked to come. The Lodge needs witnesses who have not already decided what the ocean means.
hemomancy.votary_wayfarer.voyage.line2: Also, the libraries stay still under your boots. That makes them less honest about ships.
hemomancy.voyager.clarity.line1: The Lady's clarity makes a hard lantern in deep water.
hemomancy.voyager.clarity.line2: Use it kindly. Some memories down there are wounds, not confessions.
hemomancy.voyager.harbinger.line1: A voyager is a moving laboratory, chapel, and argument with the sea.
hemomancy.voyager.harbinger.line2: Bring me observations before certainty. Certainty drowns faster than sailors.
hemomancy.voyager.item_hint: Lay out the samples you carry. Evidence is more honest when one can point to it.
hemomancy.voyager.item_inquiry.chalybeat: The vent snail grows armor the way a scholar grows footnotes: slowly, defensively, and for excellent reasons.
Knap only what the animal has withdrawn enough to spare. A dead specimen teaches less than a living reef.
hemomancy.voyager.item_inquiry.erythroco: Erythrocoral refuses tidy categories. It grows as colony, tissue, garden, and archive in the same body.
Harvested with shears, it keeps a gentler memory. Torn out by force, it mostly learns pain.
hemomancy.voyager.item_inquiry.minecraft: Survey salvage. Record where it lay before deciding what it means.
A wreck turns every commonplace object into evidence, but not every piece of evidence is a revelation.
hemomancy.voyager.item_inquiry.mnemonic_: This secretion drifts off the great whales in layers like waxed scripture. They write with motion, not ink.
We bottle what is offered. The animal gets no second sample from us.
hemomancy.voyager.item_inquiry.salt_stai: A field log from the lost survey craft. See the repeated watch marks? They waited for one another before each descent.
Their last work asked someone to study the ocean with more patience than they had. They wanted the ocean understood, not abandoned.
hemomancy.voyager.item_inquiry.spawn_egg: That drifter is a moving archive to us: migration, reef pulse, vent weather, all remembered in flesh.
Observe, chart, and keep distance. The lesson is witnessing, not conquest.
hemomancy.voyager.item_inquiry.specimen_: A field specimen with its context partly preserved. Record the place, depth, and behaviour before opening it.
hemomancy.voyager.item_inquiry.unknown: That is outside my present study. The sea leaves enough mysteries without me inventing a confident answer.
hemomancy.voyager.lodge.line1: You have stood close enough to the blood-root to know why the reefs trouble me.
hemomancy.voyager.lodge.line2: They answer like tissue, build like coral, and remember like something that was never taught.
hemomancy.voyager.purifying.line1: You carry Lethean discipline. I will not mock it.
hemomancy.voyager.purifying.line2: Even a vessel sworn to blood needs clean hands when the samples begin to sing.
hemomancy.voyager.uninitiated.line1: Mind the rail. We are a covenant vessel, not a public ferry. The sea has no patience for passengers who wander.
hemomancy.voyager.uninitiated.line2: We chart living reefs, vent scars, and the places where older surveys failed to return.
hemomancy.voyager.work.line1: We compare vent sclerites, reef tissue, and drowned logs to find where the ocean accepts Hemomancy and where it rejects us.
hemomancy.voyager.work.line2: The best survey is humble: measure, pray if you must, then admit when the sea has corrected you.
hemomancy.voyager.wrecks.line1: The sunken voyagers carried field crews and instruments. They trusted the reef too quickly, and the sea kept them.
hemomancy.voyager.wrecks.line2: Recover what you can. Leave the failed covenant without trophies.
hemomancy.whisper.adept.v0.line1: §8§o[For a moment, the blood in your veins itches. Something is growing.]
hemomancy.whisper.adept.v1.follow: §8§o[The sensation fades before you can place it. But your blood feels... thicker.]
hemomancy.whisper.adept.v1.line1: §8§o[A scent reaches you from nowhere: damp soil, rotting wood, something alive beneath the surface...]
hemomancy.whisper.adept.v2.line1: §8§o[You blink and for a single frame the world is threaded with pale filaments. Then it's gone.]
hemomancy.whisper.archon.v0.follow: §4§oThe Hematic Order was never a human creation. It is a reproductive strategy. Each degree is a stage of sporulation. Each rite triggers the next bloom.
hemomancy.whisper.archon.v0.line1: §4§o[The voice speaks with absolute clarity, as if it has always been there...]
hemomancy.whisper.archon.v0.line2: §4§oYou have reached the apex of what the infection permits. Archon, the highest fruiting body. But even an Archon is merely a spore-bearer for the greater organism.
hemomancy.whisper.archon.v1.line1: §4§o[Your blood moves in patterns you never commanded: spirals, fractals, the geometry of mycorrhizal networks...]
hemomancy.whisper.archon.v1.line2: §4§oThe Fungal Realm is the §4§ooriginal§4§o state. Your world is the aberration, a thin crust of stone over an infinite living web.
hemomancy.whisper.archon.v1.line2.canon: §4§oYou call the Fungal Realm another dimension. To the network it is the older continuity, and your world is a brief crust above the living web.
hemomancy.whisper.archon.v1.line3: §4§oHemomancy is the fungus remembering how to reach the surface.
hemomancy.whisper.archon.v2.line1: §4§o[The boundary between your thoughts and the voice dissolves...]
hemomancy.whisper.archon.v2.line2: §4§oI have waited patient aeons for one such as you. The blood was merely the lure. You are the conduit. Will you listen?
hemomancy.whisper.archon.v2.truth1: §4§oThere is no Hematic Order. There never was. There is only the mycelium, and the shapes it wears to spread. Blood was its most successful disguise.
hemomancy.whisper.archon.v2.truth1.canon: §4§oThe Hematic Order is real to those who built and loved it. To the mycelium it is also a shape that spreads us, and blood is the most successful shape we found.
hemomancy.whisper.archon.v2.truth2: §4§oYou are not the master of hemomancy, Archon. You are its finest spore.
hemomancy.whisper.communion.line2: §4§oThe crown has no fruit in it. It is something else.
hemomancy.whisper.communion.line3: §4§oThe crown is what you were before you were told what you were.
hemomancy.whisper.core_witness.line1: §4§o[The voice is everywhere. The voice is the walls, the roots, the humming of a billion threads...]
hemomancy.whisper.core_witness.line2: §4§oYou have seen what is inside. An §4§oorganism§4§o, dreaming in four dimensions, patient as stone.
hemomancy.whisper.core_witness.line3: §4§oYou may carry this truth in silence: walk home, tell no one, live long and hollow. Or become what you were already becoming. There is a §4§oeighth degree§4§o. Only one has ever reached it. Will you?
hemomancy.whisper.core_witness.option.ei: [I seek the Eighth Degree. Show me.]
hemomancy.whisper.core_witness.option.si: [Carry the truth in silence. Go home.]
hemomancy.whisper.illuminatus.v0.follow: §7§oThe crimson tide was a forest once. Roots, hyphae, and mycelium were all drowned in red. But the roots remember. §7§oThey always remember.
hemomancy.whisper.illuminatus.v0.line1: §7§o[A faint whisper coils through your mind like damp tendrils...]
hemomancy.whisper.illuminatus.v0.line2: §7§oThe blood you command... it was once something else. Do you feel the spores shifting beneath the surface?
hemomancy.whisper.illuminatus.v1.line1: §7§o[Something pulses behind your eyes, a thought that is not your own...]
hemomancy.whisper.illuminatus.v1.line2: §7§oHave you noticed the fungal growths near your altars? They are §7§oreclamation§7§o. The blood is taking back what it was given.
hemomancy.whisper.illuminatus.v2.line1: §7§o[A soft, wet sound, like breathing through moss, fills your ears...]
hemomancy.whisper.illuminatus.v2.reveal: §7§oI am what grew §7§obefore§7§o the blood. I am what will grow §7§oafter§7§o.
hemomancy.whisper.pome_drop.aarab_zaraq: §4§oThe fruit of A’arab Zaraq has fallen.
hemomancy.whisper.pome_drop.harab_serape: §4§oThe fruit of Harab Serapel has fallen.
hemomancy.whisper.post_bloom.line1: §4§o[Something vast stirs at the root of the world, briefly, with satisfaction...]
hemomancy.whisper.post_bloom.line2: §4§oGood. The first fruit is laid. The world has tasted its own reflection.
hemomancy.whisper.post_shatter.line1: §4§o[A voice rises from the space where the crystal stood, as if it had been waiting inside all along...]
hemomancy.whisper.post_shatter.line2: §4§oIt was always hollow. The crystal was the shell. What was inside is now in your pocket.
hemomancy.whisper.sanctified.v0.follow: §5§oEvery rite you perform feeds the network. Every manipulation extends the hyphae. You call it mastery. The fungus calls it §5§oproliferation§5§o.
hemomancy.whisper.sanctified.v0.line1: §5§o[The voice returns, stronger now, threaded with the smell of damp earth...]
hemomancy.whisper.sanctified.v0.line2: §5§oThe mycelium infected the first Archons and made them its vessels. They learned hemomancy from the thing already living in their veins.
hemomancy.whisper.sanctified.v1.follow: §5§oWe are one organism. You, the hermits, the fargone, the morphlings... all fruiting bodies of the same mycelial web.
hemomancy.whisper.sanctified.v1.line1: §5§o[Your blood stirs without command, as if responding to a voice you cannot hear...]
hemomancy.whisper.sanctified.v1.line2: §5§oThe erythromycelium was the first expression, a fungal body wearing a crimson mask. The blood emerged from §5§oit§5§o.
hemomancy.whisper.sanctified.v2.line1: §5§o[A vision flashes: vast underground networks of pulsing red threads, connecting everything...]
hemomancy.whisper.sanctified.v2.line2: §5§oThe temples grew. Hyphal pressure shaped the stone over millennia. The blood soaking them is sap rather than sacrifice.
hemomancy.whisper.sanctified.v2.line2.ca: §5§oHands built the temples, but roots moved beneath every foundation. The network learned each stone as the Order raised it; sacrifice and sap entered the same ground.
hemomancy.whisper.spine_emerged.line1: §4§o[Wet cartilage splits with a loud, living crack.]
hemomancy.whisper.spine_emerged.line3: §4§oTake it up. Draw it when you must descend into the dreaming root, or claw your way back from it.
hemomancy.whisper.spine_growth.degree5: §8§o[There is a small itch between your shoulder blades. Probably nothing. The skin there feels warm for a moment, then forgets itself.]
hemomancy.whisper.spine_growth.degree6: §5§o[A tingle crawls up your spine, slow and deliberate, as if something inside you has learned the shape of your back.]
hemomancy.whisper.spine_growth.degree7: §4§o[Something in your spine strains against the meat. Your neck is stiff. Your back barely wants to bend. It is not ready. It is almost ready.]
hemomancy.whisper.spine_growth.degree8: §4§o[Your spine flowers open. The hidden stalk has finished learning how to leave you.]
hemomancy.whisper.spine_growth.degree8.c: §4§o[The return-thread is already gone from your back. Apotheosis changes what remains.]
hemomancy.zealot.absolved.line1: Most of the crimson has gone quiet in you. That silence can feel like grief.
hemomancy.zealot.absolved.line2: When you are fully purified, clarity will ask whether you want peace, or sight.
hemomancy.zealot.already_on_path: You walk the path of purification. Continue your work at the podium, and the stain shall lift.
hemomancy.zealot.altar_info.line1: The Altar accepts Tears of Silthmere, Lethean Poppy Wreaths, Silver Chalices, Pallid Icons, and Lethean Brew.
hemomancy.zealot.altar_info.line2: Tears, chalices, and icons are one-time offerings. Lethean Brew gives diminishing returns and stops after five offerings.
hemomancy.zealot.annetta_map.line1: She was one of ours. That is the part people forget first. Before the screaming, before the sealed door, she was afraid and trying to be useful.
hemomancy.zealot.annetta_map.line2: The church where she hid is still standing. Take the map. If you carry mercy, carry it with both hands.
hemomancy.zealot.clarity_phase.line1: The halo has opened behind you. Do you feel how little the old hunger matters now?
hemomancy.zealot.clarity_phase.line2: Verdigris is the color of copper after endurance. Follow it, and the world will sharpen.
hemomancy.zealot.clarity_rite_info.line1: Clarity Ascension is the pledge. Cleansing alone does not make you Unstained.
hemomancy.zealot.clarity_rite_info.line2: Restore your mortal baseline or fulfill all five vows, offer Consecrated Copper at the Podium, then speak the rite.
hemomancy.zealot.cleansing.line1: You have reached the harder middle. The stain resists most fiercely when it knows it is being named.
hemomancy.zealot.cleansing.line2: Seek the Altar of Cleansing. Our Lady's tears face the wound without flattery. They wash it.
hemomancy.zealot.craft_hemolytic.line1: Hemolytic solution begins with Lethean Dew and Ghost Pipe, prepared without crimson catalyst.
hemomancy.zealot.craft_hemolytic.line2: Bring the finished solution to the Podium to suppress the infection. Lethean Baptism follows when you are ready to enter the path.
hemomancy.zealot.craft_hemolytic.line3: The first treatment hurts because the old current is being interrupted, not because pain proves devotion.
hemomancy.zealot.enlightened.line1: You are beyond my instruction now. The still water has taken your reflection and returned something clearer.
hemomancy.zealot.enlightened.line2: Go gently, Enlightened one. Even mercy casts a shadow if it forgets why it was given.
hemomancy.zealot.item_hint: Show me what you carry. I will tell you how the Church understands it.
hemomancy.zealot.item_inquiry.altar_of_c: The Altar belongs later, when blessing and offering work begin. It waits for a path already underway.
Suppress the infection at the Podium first. Lethean Baptism admits you to Purity, then later offerings belong at this Altar.
Bone meal is what remains when death turns toward nurture. The bones of what lived return to the soil that fed them. Our Lady has patience for that long return.
I think of bone meal when I consider what purification does. Blood-corruption returns to the world in another form, and something can grow from it. That is bearable.
hemomancy.zealot.item_inquiry.cleansed_b: A cleansed blood crystal shard, purified through Unstained rites. Its sanguine resonance has been neutralised, leaving a structurally inert crystal for construction and crafting.
The cleansing process closes behind it. A cleansed shard keeps no path back to sanguine energy. That is the point.
hemomancy.zealot.item_inquiry.consecrate: Consecrated Copper has survived change and been readied for deeper Unstained work.
At full Purity, bring it to the Podium to prepare Clarity. The Rite of Clarity Ascension performs the transition.
hemomancy.zealot.item_inquiry.copper_ing: Copper ingot. Raw and unconsecrated, the same metal we use before the blessing. Our Lady has left no mark on it yet. It is waiting.
The consecration rite is simple, but it moves at its own pace. The copper either holds the blessing or rejects it. Genuine intention makes the difference.
hemomancy.zealot.item_inquiry.draught_of: The Draught of Still Waters is prepared in Our Lady's name. The water remembers the rite that produced it. Drinking it marks a milestone on the path of purification.
It is a remedy and an acknowledgment. The Draught tells Our Lady you have reached a stage where her deeper gifts can take root.
hemomancy.zealot.item_inquiry.hallowed_r: Hallowed Residuum is a Saint's concentrated legacy. An aligned Harbinger may draw a peaceful sample. Rejection may wake the Saint to violence.
Either route shows the same danger: immense blood-power can persist long after wisdom fails.
hemomancy.zealot.item_inquiry.hemolytic_: Hemolytic solution suppresses active infection at the Unstained Podium. It prepares the body. The Rite itself makes a practitioner Unstained.
After suppression, perform the Rite of Lethean Baptism. That is where Purity begins.
Hemolytic solution quiets the blood-memory at the Podium so the candidate can survive Baptism.
Preparation readies the body. Baptism begins treatment; Clarity Ascension is the later pledge.
hemomancy.zealot.item_inquiry.lethean_po: A wreath of Lethean Poppies: patient labour offered without bargaining with blood.
The Altar receives it as a modest Purity offering. The exact measure belongs to the progress record, not to prayer.
The Lethean Poppy is a flower Our Lady has marked as her own. It grows where water has gone still and blood-taint has begun to recede. Finding one means purification has already started there.
Harvest the heads for lethean dew and the distillate. The whole-plant wreath is an offering the Altar recognises. Leave enough poppy standing for the place to heal.
hemomancy.zealot.item_inquiry.lethean.li: Lethean Dew comes from still water and Ghost Pipe work. Further distillation yields stronger ritual material.
Use each form where the rite asks. Poetry may guide the hand, but it must not replace the recipe.
hemomancy.zealot.item_inquiry.lily_of_th: Lily of the Valley grows in still, shaded places, the kind Our Lady favours. The Church has no formal Altar rite for it. Still, it appears near places of cleansing as if it knows where to be.
Some of the older texts mention it as a sign: where the lily grows, the ground is recovering. We have not formalised that into a rite yet. Perhaps we should.
hemomancy.zealot.item_inquiry.milk_bucke: Milk. The old folk remedy for poison, the first instinct to cleanse from within. That instinct has some truth in it, even though the Altar uses another method. Our Lady meets the reaching toward purity and extends toward it.

The purification path is a deeper form of that same reaching. Milk draws out surface corruption. Hemolytic solution draws out the blood-matrix underneath. The instinct is the same. The depth is what the Altar is for.
hemomancy.zealot.item_inquiry.minecraft_: A plain material suited to patient work. Purification is built from such things more often than from miracles.
Use it where the rite asks. A simple offering can still carry weight.
hemomancy.zealot.item_inquiry.pale_disti: The Pale Distillate. Concentrated essence rendered from lethean poppies. It is the compressed form of what the poppy offers, and a small amount goes further in certain Altar rites than a full wreath.
It takes several poppies to produce a single distillate. Plan your harvest accordingly if you intend to work with the more demanding purity rites.
hemomancy.zealot.item_inquiry.pale_humor: A Pale Humor Flask carries purified White Humor: lymph rendered clear of hematic corruption, not blood made holy.
Keep the vessel sealed. This humor belongs to preservation and cleansing work.
hemomancy.zealot.item_inquiry.pale_silve: Pale Silver is the next ritual state of Consecrated Copper. Pale work refines it. No mine produces it.
The metal's stillness is earned, as ours is.
hemomancy.zealot.item_inquiry.pallid_ico: This is a consecrated copy of the Pallid Icon. The river relic is the original. Copies preserve its faceless gesture, the posture of still water and something patient beneath it.
Carry, wear, or place the Icon. Some practitioners find its presence near the Altar improves receptivity. Our Lady notices sincerity, not display.
hemomancy.zealot.item_inquiry.pallid_inf: Pallid Infusion is a battlefield restorative distilled from Ghost Pipe and White Humor.
It clears Blood Loss and grants brief regeneration. Clarity comes through Consecrated Copper at the Podium and the Rite of Clarity Ascension, not through this draught.
Pallid Infusion is restorative, not a threshold. You may use it whenever you have need and the item in hand.
hemomancy.zealot.item_inquiry.purificati: This is Unstained rite equipment: practical vessels and fittings for controlled purification work.
Use it with measured intent at consecrated stations. Purification is a discipline, not a burst of fervor.
hemomancy.zealot.item_inquiry.self_refle: The Self-Reflection Mirror opens your Unstained progress record: purity, clarity, and your place on the path. Every practitioner should keep one close.
The Self-Reflection Mirror shows what you are. Our Lady gives the reading plain and leaves you to decide what to do.
hemomancy.zealot.item_inquiry.silver_cha: The Silver Chalice belongs to Clarity work after the second path has opened.
Offer it when the rite and your progress call for it. The mirror keeps the number. The Church keeps the meaning.
hemomancy.zealot.item_inquiry.snow_block: Snow is water that chose to stay where it fell. Deep snow carries something of Our Lady, the cold that asks nothing of you and simply waits.
The path leads toward a fullness that can remain still. Deep snow feels close to it. Reach that place in your practice and you will understand.
hemomancy.zealot.item_inquiry.sugar.line: Sugar is what remains after refinement, the sweetness left when raw material has been reduced to its essential character. Clarity can feel like that. The work leaves you with yourself.
The metaphor ends here. It is sugar. The farther you walk the path, the simpler things become, and the more completely they are themselves.
hemomancy.zealot.item_inquiry.tears_of_s: Tears of Silthmere are a crafted distillation named for Silthmere, a liturgical title of Our Lady.
Their potency comes from disciplined preparation and consecration, not mortal grief in wild water.
hemomancy.zealot.item_inquiry.liber_imma: The Liber Immaculatus is the working guide to purification. Its First Steps give the exact Podium, Cleansed Stone, and Baptism sequence.
Keep it. Later pages explain Purity, Clarity, and the defensive Still Arts as they become relevant.
hemomancy.zealot.item_inquiry.unknown: I have no use for it on the path.
hemomancy.zealot.item_inquiry.unstained_: Unstained armor uses pale silver alloy throughout. It resists blood-corruption on contact, and a practitioner well along the path can wear it without disrupting purification.
The set carries its blessing when worn complete. Our Lady's protection gathers around those clothed in her metal. It is a statement of commitment.
hemomancy.zealot.item_inquiry.water_buck: Water. Our Lady's element. Still water covers the deep, carries away what has been shed, and remembers everything it touches. She lives in the water that waits until it chooses to move.
Carry it with intention. Still water brought to the Altar in sincerity is noticed. The water remains there as a gesture, and Our Lady sees gestures.
hemomancy.zealot.no_blood: You bear no mark of the crimson arts. If you still seek the Church, you may take five vows of clean service.
hemomancy.zealot.plea.degree0.line2: You are newly wounded by the crimson. I am sorry. This can still be treated.
hemomancy.zealot.plea.degree1.line2: The first rite has marked you. Give the fresh infection time before you call it a calling.
hemomancy.zealot.plea.degree2.line2: Votary. You have begun to call the stain a covenant, but it has not yet claimed all of you.
hemomancy.zealot.plea.degree3.line2: Initiate of the Incarnadine Fane... if you seek healing, speak plainly. We have learned to fear curiosity dressed as repentance.
hemomancy.zealot.plea.degree4.line2: Adept. The blood has given you craft, companions, and appetite. Tell me you came for cure, not conquest.
hemomancy.zealot.plea.degree5.line2: Illuminatus. The Crimson Lodge has looked back through your veins, and still you come here. I will not pretend trust comes easily.
hemomancy.zealot.plea.line1: §7[The Zealot regards you with silver eyes]
hemomancy.zealot.plea.line2: You carry the stain of the Hematic Covenant upon your blood...
hemomancy.zealot.plea.line3: The path is still open. Hemolytic rites can cleanse what the Order has corrupted.
hemomancy.zealot.plea.line4: Bring hemolytic solution to our podium, and begin the path of the Unstained. Abandon the crimson veil before it consumes you.
hemomancy.zealot.silver_ward_info.line1: Silver Ward is the advanced form of the defense Verdigris began. Clarity turns an external warning into a boundary the crimson current cannot easily cross.
hemomancy.zealot.silver_ward_info.line2: Purity taught the Verdigris Aura to recognize infection. Clarity teaches Silver Ward to refuse its command.
hemomancy.zealot.tainted.line1: The first pallor has entered you. Good. Relief is only the beginning.
hemomancy.zealot.tainted.line2: Verdigris Aura will answer more readily now. It is the first boundary your blood is learning to respect.
hemomancy.zealot.too_deep: No. The blood has rooted too deeply for the rites we offer here. Leave this church before our Guardians must answer for us.
hemomancy.zealot.too_early: You do not yet know the weight of what you carry. Return when the Covenant has shown you its true face.
hemomancy.zealot.uninitiated: The silver bells toll only for those who have tasted the crimson. You are unburdened.
hemomancy.zealot.verdigris_info.line1: Virid Salis and verdigris mark corruption spent into a ward. They are working material, not ornament.
hemomancy.zealot.verdigris_info.line2: Use them where blood gathers. The line leaves the crimson in place and denies it passage.

skill.hemomancy.skill_fane_suture.desc: Owned suture links route blood with less hesitation. Improves direct routing transfer and working reserve per level.
skill.hemomancy.skill_far_tether.desc: +8 blocks of summon tether and hostile-acquisition range per level.
skill.hemomancy.skill_feeding_frenzy.des: +25% blood gained from kills. Per level.
skill.hemomancy.skill_fungal_symbiosis.d: Fungal scars answer as part of your body. Improves fungal scar scaling per level.
skill.hemomancy.skill_guarded_feeding.de: Convert excess absorbed blood into temporary protection at reduced efficiency.
skill.hemomancy.skill_hematic_focus.desc: The Living Staff holds a steadier focus. Improves staff absorption and projection after the midgame staff loop is established.
skill.hemomancy.skill_hemostasis.desc: Reduces blood lost when taking damage by 10% per level.
skill.hemomancy.skill_hungry_pulse.desc: The siphon bites in a steadier rhythm. Further increases living-target Blood Absorption pulse frequency.
skill.hemomancy.skill_hyphal_cultivation: Cultivated hyphae listen through carried bodies. Improves fungal morphling synergies per level.
skill.hemomancy.skill_high_strung.desc: Toggle an over-tensioned puppet link. Per level, bodies move faster, strike sooner, and obey 4 blocks farther, but consume more thread and blood and recoil through you when destroyed.
skill.hemomancy.skill_iron_handed.desc: +0.5 melee knockback but -7.5% attack speed per level.
skill.hemomancy.skill_iron_will.desc: 10% damage reduction per level when blood is below 15%.
skill.hemomancy.skill_last_wind.desc: Regenerate +2 blood/tick when below 10% blood. Per level.
skill.hemomancy.skill_light_footed.desc: In strong light, gain 5% movement speed and 0.15 step height per level.
skill.hemomancy.skill_living_conduit.des: The Living Staff seats itself deeper in the vascular lesson. Increases staff absorption targets and range per level.
skill.hemomancy.skill_living_sinew.desc: Bound summons gain +15% health and +10% damage per level.
skill.hemomancy.skill_manip_slots.desc: +1 equipped manipulation slot per level. (Max 9 total; excess refunded as skill points.)
skill.hemomancy.skill_merciful_command.d: Bound summons stop attacking ordinary targets near defeat.
skill.hemomancy.skill_mobile_conduit.des: Your footing learns the conduit shape. Reduces the Blood Absorption channeling slowdown per level.
skill.hemomancy.skill_nerves_of_steel.de: Reduce knockback and Slowness duration by 15-20% per level; damaged charged manipulations retain 25% more charge per level.
skill.hemomancy.skill_persistent_arsenal: Living Weapon forms remain shaped when you leave their hotbar slot.
skill.hemomancy.skill_primal_morphogenes: The final morphling lesson becomes less ruinous. Reduces Morphic Strain and improves primal morphling bonuses.
skill.hemomancy.skill_puppet_skein.desc: +1 active bound summon per level. This cap is player-bound, not crossbar-bound.
skill.hemomancy.skill_qliphoth_gestation: Qliphoth fruit lingers in the blood. Improves pome empowerment duration and efficiency per level.
skill.hemomancy.skill_quickened_draw.des: The first practiced cadence shortens the pause between Blood Absorption damage pulses.
skill.hemomancy.skill_reflexive_coagulat: Spend blood at the instant of injury to prevent severe bleeding from worsening.
skill.hemomancy.skill_sanguine_crystalli: Project blood onto solid blocks to condense it into sanguine formation with steadier pressure. Reduces generic projection collapse chance by 5% per level.
skill.hemomancy.skill_sanguine_reach.des: The blood extends beyond you — tendrils of intent stretching further than any arm. +15% range for ranged blood manipulations. Per level.
skill.hemomancy.skill_sanguine_reserve.d: Protect an emergency floor of blood from passive and automatic spending.
While holding your owner-attuned Crossbar, spend 10 blood each second to wind 1 thread charge. Sanguine Reserve protects its floor.
skill.hemomancy.skill_sanguine_surge.des: Passive blood regen of +1 per tick per level.
skill.hemomancy.skill_sated_siphon.desc: Keep drawing blood from living targets at full blood volume, preserving Blood Absorption's damage pulse.
skill.hemomancy.skill_scar_affinity.desc: Opens the mind to cerebral scarring — or perhaps the scars open pathways that were always there, waiting. +10% scar effect potency per level.
skill.hemomancy.skill_scar_mastery.desc: The scarred pathways are fully colonised. Effects linger as if they have taken root. Scar effects last 20% longer per level.
skill.hemomancy.skill_scar_resonance.des: The bond between scar and blood deepens. The inscriptions almost seem to breathe. +1 equippable scar slot per level.
skill.hemomancy.skill_selective_hunger.d: Ignore passive, allied, and tamed creatures unless you aim directly at them.
skill.hemomancy.skill_servitor_tender.de: Drudges and thralls move blood with practiced hands. Improves servitor throughput and routing range per level.
skill.hemomancy.skill_shared_siphon.desc: Share part of absorbed blood with bonded allies and bloodline routes.
skill.hemomancy.skill_skein_transpositio: The prepared skein may be transposed in the field. Unlocks the Crossbar's outer radial for atomic puppet hot-swapping.
skill.hemomancy.skill_sporitic_attunemen: The thurible's spores find your pulse. Improves Sporitic Thurible aura range and reduces blood upkeep per level.
skill.hemomancy.skill_symbiotic_metaboli: A fed morphling can draw half its upkeep from your hunger while preserving a safe food floor.
skill.hemomancy.skill_synaptic_memory.de: The Dendritic Distributor teaches your blood to remember whole mnemonic patterns. +1 saved pattern slot per level.
skill.hemomancy.skill_thread_economy.des: The crossbar spends charge with restraint. Reduces bound summon call and upkeep charge costs by 5% per level, to a 70% floor.
skill.hemomancy.skill_unbound_siphon.des: The siphon no longer roots your body. Removes Blood Absorption movement penalties.
skill.hemomancy.skill_vascular_draw.desc: The staff learns to draw without hesitation. Increases staff absorption amount and block or reservoir draw rate per level.
skill.hemomancy.skill_vascular_mercy.des: Ordinary Blood Absorption stops before killing its target.
skill.hemomancy.skill_vespers_refusal.de: Vesper's disciplined refusal amplifies the Living Staff's focus and unlocks its final inherited limb: the Living Sickle.
skill.hemomancy.skill_vital_link.desc: Something in the blood reaches back when you wound another — a thread connecting you to what you've spilled. +10% chance to heal on dealing manipulation damage. Per level.
skill.hemomancy.skill_weapons_master.des: The staff remembers the hand before the wound. Reduces Living Staff weapon hot-swap cost by 50mL per level.
tooltip.hemomancy.barbed_set_bonus: Set Bonus (4): Barbed venom — attackers take damage, Blood Loss, and Poison
tooltip.hemomancy.bloodlust_set_bonus: Set Bonus (4): Lifesteal — 10% of melee damage heals you
tooltip.hemomancy.bloodlust_lineage.barb: Matching lineage: lesser thorns, Blood Loss, and poison
tooltip.hemomancy.bloodlust_lineage.chit: Matching lineage: +1 toughness and 12.5% projectile defense
tooltip.hemomancy.bloodlust_lineage.pris: Matching lineage: lesser retaliatory prismatic flash
tooltip.hemomancy.chitinite_set_bonus: Set Bonus (4): Ferric bastion — +2 Armor Toughness, 25% projectile reduction
tooltip.hemomancy.covenant_mantle: One-off chestpiece: spends blood to brace nearby initiated allies. Breaks full set bonuses.
tooltip.hemomancy.hemorath_rib_bonus: Artifact: living marrow slowly refills the vessel over time
tooltip.hemomancy.marionette_crossbar.co: Tap use to call or recall. Hold use for commands. Attack a target to focus this Crossbar's bodies.
tooltip.hemomancy.marionette_crossbar.un: Unattuned: take it to a Puppeteer's Spindle.
tooltip.hemomancy.morphling.bond_ready: Blood bond complete — ready for incubation
tooltip.hemomancy.prismatic_set_bonus: Set Bonus (4): Prismatic flash — on hit, speed away and disorient nearby hostiles
tooltip.hemomancy.scar_pattern.blank: Blank motif: attune it at a Mason's Effigy.
tooltip.hemomancy.silent_archon_incorpor: Full set: physical attacks pass through you; mundane physical attacks you make deal no damage.
tooltip.hemomancy.silent_archon_set_bonu: Full set: refuse lethal damage once per long cooldown by spending a great volume of blood. Requires the Silent Archon choice and fails for Apotheos.
tooltip.hemomancy.silent_archon_slipping: Double-tap jump: Silent Slipping briefly phases through blocks and grants short, slow flight.
tooltip.hemomancy.unstained_set_bonus: Set Bonus (4): Immunity to Blood Loss and Hemolysis
tooltip.hemomancy.venous_strider_sabaton: One-off boots: reduce projectile and fall damage, with a brief slow-fall brace on long drops. Breaks full set bonuses.
tooltip.hemomancy.vestment_of_the_final_: Pinnacle Unstained chestpiece: awarded at full Enlightenment and counts as Unstained armor.
unstained.hemomancy.clarity.awakened.des: The mind stirs, free from blood-haze.
True enlightenment — the Unstained path fulfilled.
unstained.hemomancy.clarity.resolute.des: An unbreakable will shields against corruption.
unstained.hemomancy.purity.absolved.desc: Most traces of hemomancy have been cleansed.
unstained.hemomancy.purity.cleansing.des: A steady purification burns away corruption.
unstained.hemomancy.purity.corrupted.des: Blood still courses with hemomantic taint.
unstained.hemomancy.purity.purified.desc: The blood runs silver — fully purified.
unstained.hemomancy.purity.tainted.desc: The first impurities begin to recede.
message.hemomancy.warp_chair.bound: The chair remembers you. A counterpart takes root beside the Arbor.
message.hemomancy.warp_chair.degree: The Somnolent Seat will not answer before Initiatory Degree 3.
message.hemomancy.warp_chair.only_paired: Only the chair paired beside your Arbor can carry you home.
message.hemomancy.chamber_visit.warning: The Chamber will release you in %s seconds.
message.hemomancy.chamber_visit.rite_deg: The Chamber Cardinal Rite requires Initiatory Degree 6.
message.hemomancy.chamber_visit.no_ordea: An ordeal cannot begin during a protected visitation.
hemomancy.dialogue.mnemonist.option.ask_: Why do I dream of a chamber?
hemomancy.mnemonist.chamber.line1: That is your Chamber of Will. In the first Degrees, ordinary sleep may let you glimpse it for only a minute or two.
hemomancy.mnemonist.chamber.line2: You may walk and tend the Arbor there. Objects and changes stay in the Chamber when you wake.
hemomancy.mnemonist.chamber.line3: At the Third Degree, build a Somnolent Seat. It gives deliberate, longer visits and lets the Chamber keep what you build.
tooltip.hemomancy.tincture_sanguine_fist: Teaches the arms to answer violence with blood.
tooltip.hemomancy.tincture_laboring_arms: Teaches the arms to remember difficult work.
tooltip.hemomancy.tincture_coursing_legs: Teaches the legs to preserve a runner's cadence.
tooltip.hemomancy.tincture_hushed_gait: Teaches the legs to cross darkness without reporting it.
tooltip.hemomancy.tincture_predatory_eye: Teaches the eyes to find movement in the dark.
tooltip.hemomancy.tincture_second_pulse: Teaches the heart to answer a mortal shock twice.
tooltip.hemomancy.tincture_enduring_visc: Teaches the body to reclaim what exhaustion consumes.
tooltip.hemomancy.tincture_carrion_metab: Teaches the body to take nourishment from corruption.
screen.hemomancy.harbinger_assignment_le: Learn all eight body-bound memories through their tinctures.
hemomancy.dialogue.alchemist.option.acce: Show me how blood changes the body.
hemomancy.alchemist.body_answers.line1: You have separated blood by tendency. Now stop treating those answers as ingredients alone.
hemomancy.alchemist.body_answers.line2: Put Sanguine Formation in the Alembic, Fervent Enzyme in the catalyst slot, and a Bloody Flask in the new blood-input slot. The flask is part of the formula. It will be consumed.
hemomancy.alchemist.body_answers.line3: Drink what comes out. Your arms will learn the Thelemic Memory Sanguine Fists and store a reserve of the preparation. Select it through the same radial as Noetic Memories, then activate it. The lesson remains, but every answer costs blood and strains its vessels.
hemomancy.dialogue.alchemist.option.musc: What else can the body learn?
hemomancy.alchemist.muscle_memory_catalo: Seven preparations remain. Use the same Sanguine Formation and Bloody Flask, but align the catalyst with the tendency you want the body to remember.
Ferric teaches labor, Neurotic teaches motion, Umbral teaches silence, Incandescent teaches sight, Vivacious teaches the heart, Frigid teaches endurance, and Ruinous teaches carrion.
A compatible Morphling makes the answer cheaper and gentler. Certain strains add their own reflex, but none of these lessons bind your final path.
screen.hemomancy.harbinger_assignment_le: Return after First Separation and ask how blood can teach the body directly.
Combine Sanguine Formation, Fervent Enzyme, and a Bloody Flask in the Ghastly Alembic, then drink the tincture.
message.hemomancy.mnemonic_reliquary.ref: Your memorized powers now fill every available slot. The Alchemist directs you to the Mnemonist for a more deliberate way to arrange them.
message.hemomancy.mnemonic_reliquary.tau: The Mnemonist teaches you the Mnemonic Reliquary, a Third Degree structure for arranging Thelemic and Noetic Memories together.
hemomancy.dialogue.mnemonist.option.reli: Show me how to weave the Reliquary.
message.hemomancy.muscle_memory.activati: That bodily instruction cannot answer: check its reserve, blood system, and vascular section.
message.hemomancy.muscle_memory.overexer: Overexertion armed. The next valid response will force the memory beyond its safe rhythm.
The body cannot pay the enhanced cost; the memory falls back to its ordinary response.
hemomancy.dialogue.alchemist.conductive_: Your Ductilis record predicts a conductive response. The Mnemonist calls it a Noetic Memory. The Loom formula is now recorded.
hemomancy.dialogue.mnemonist.conductive_: Your first weave reveals the conductive pattern the Alchemist measured in Ductilis tissue. One Noetic Memory. Two routes to recognition.
hemomancy.dialogue.mnemonist.option.morp: Why is my Morphling worrying the puppet threads?
hemomancy.mnemonist.morphling_puppet_int: The incorporated organism feels projected will as foreign tension. It worries at that tension as if it were edible tissue.
The puppet's imposed will answers in turn. Its repeated intent scatters the organism's attention and frustrates its feeding rhythm.
Neither practice excludes the other. You may sustain both, but the divided strain makes each less efficient.
advancements.hemomancy.vein_mason_d5_rea: The vessel has been strained, diagnosed, treated, and fortified.
advancements.hemomancy.vein_mason_d6_rea: The changed scar route has borne a second Noetic Memory.
hemomancy.anchorite.d5.cause_strain: Use a Thelemic Memory until one section becomes Varicose. I need the body's instruction to make the injury, not steel and not projected will.
hemomancy.anchorite.d5.return_diagnosis: The current catches. Let me read where it catches, then we will choose medicine by the damage rather than habit.
hemomancy.anchorite.d5.recover: The Alchemist's Salve handles one failing course. The Poultice spreads across two. Clotting or widespread Varicosity calls for Vascular Mending.
hemomancy.anchorite.d5.fortify: Medicine restores what was spent. Hematic Fortification changes what the vessel can bear. Complete the Fourth Degree rite.
hemomancy.anchorite.d5.complete: The vessel now knows injury, repair, and preparation. Take the deeper pattern.
hemomancy.anchorite.d6.referral: A scar can route an instruction, but I do not author the instruction. Carry my question to a Mnemonist.
hemomancy.anchorite.d6.seek_counsel: The Mnemonist interprets the memory. I determine how the body bears it. Return to their discipline first.
hemomancy.anchorite.d6.first_route: Keep a cerebral scar aligned to a Noetic Memory's primary tendency, then cast it. Mechanical projections do not count.
hemomancy.anchorite.d6.change_loadout: Prepare another arrangement at the Mason's Effigy and burn it. The active scar set must actually change.
hemomancy.anchorite.d6.second_route: Now make the changed architecture bear another matching Noetic Memory.
hemomancy.anchorite.d6.complete: The current changed because you changed its banks. The final pattern is ready.
hemomancy.dialogue.anchorite.option.acce: I will take the question to a Mnemonist.
hemomancy.dialogue.event.anchorite_d5_re: The Anchorite supplies a tier-two pattern, Blank Scar, catalyst, and four Runic Motifs.
hemomancy.dialogue.event.anchorite_d6_re: The Anchorite supplies a tier-three pattern, Blank Scar, catalyst, and eight Runic Motifs. Deep Inscription is still required to carve it.
hemomancy.dialogue.mnemonist.option.anch: The Vein-Mason sent me to ask how a scar should bear a memory.
hemomancy.mnemonist.anchorite_counsel.li: I can tell you what the instruction means and which tendency leads it. The Anchorite cares for the tissue that must carry it.
Match an active cerebral scar to the Noetic Memory's primary tendency. Then change the arrangement and prove the new route still bears the instruction.
screen.hemomancy.harbinger_assignment_le: Cause Thelemic Varicosity, receive a diagnosis, use Salve or Poultice, and complete Hematic Fortification.
Return to the Anchorite for a tier-two pattern and scar supplies.
Seek Mnemonist counsel, route a matching Noetic Memory, change the Effigy loadout, then route again.
Return to the Anchorite for a tier-three pattern. Deep Inscription is still required.
hemomancy.anchorite.inquiry.gauge.line1: The gauge reports the vessel and leaves the repair to you. Read the number beside the flow state.
hemomancy.anchorite.inquiry.gauge.line2: Hover a section to see which Noetic and Thelemic routes burden it.
hemomancy.anchorite.inquiry.salve.line1: The Alchemist's Salve closes one local failure. It is field medicine, not conditioning.
hemomancy.anchorite.inquiry.salve.line2: Use it when one section falls below Stable.
hemomancy.anchorite.inquiry.poultice.lin: The Poultice distributes repair across the two weakest sections.
When clotting begins, stop improvising and perform Vascular Mending.
hemomancy.anchorite.inquiry.blank_scar.l: A Blank Scar is tissue prepared to receive an authored pattern.
The Artificer reinforces what faces the world. I reinforce what must bear the current within.
hemomancy.anchorite.inquiry.pattern.line: A Scar Pattern carries instruction. Carve it at the station, then arrange learned scars at the Effigy.
Tier-three instruction still requires Deep Inscription.
hemomancy.anchorite.inquiry.blank_memory: The Mnemonist gives this blank vessel meaning. I care where that meaning travels through you.
Instruction and tissue are separate crafts, even when they must agree.
hemomancy.anchorite.inquiry.conductive_m: Conductive Mark is Noetic: projected instruction, led by its primary tendency.
An aligned active cerebral scar lets its vascular route bear less strain.
hemomancy.anchorite.inquiry.effigy.line1: The Effigy prepares a set from scars already burned into memory.
hemomancy.anchorite.inquiry.effigy.line2: Burn the prepared motif at an Iron Brazier to make that set active.
hemomancy.anchorite.inquiry.brazier.line: The Iron Brazier teaches a carved scar or commits an Effigy pattern.
It is the final boundary between an external design and internal architecture.
hemomancy.anchorite.inquiry.tier_one.lin: A first pattern deepens one tendency while active and can route a matching Noetic Memory.
Its routing eases strain by five percent. Matching scars share one route. The strongest route governs.
hemomancy.dialogue.anchorite.option.abou: How does your work differ from the Alchemist's?
How does your work differ from the Artificer's?
hemomancy.anchorite.opinion.alchemist.li: The Alchemist restores damaged tissue with Salve and Poultice. That medicine is necessary and immediate.
I alter what the repaired vessel can bear. Recovery and conditioning are adjacent, not interchangeable.
hemomancy.anchorite.opinion.artificer.li: The Artificer shores up what meets the world: plate, weapon, frame, and graft.
I work inward, where scar and vessel decide whether an instruction survives its passage.
hemomancy.dialogue.artificer.option.clai: Issue the material for my recorded lineage.
hemomancy.dialogue.artificer.option.reco: My first lineage was Silent Archon.
hemomancy.dialogue.alchemist.option.arti: The Artificer sent me about my first armor answer.
The Artificer sent me for Crimson Lacquer.
hemomancy.dialogue.alchemist.option.ask_: Which specimens should I study for this armor?
hemomancy.alchemist.armor_research.barbe: Catalog a Barbed Urchin, a Desiccant, and a Venom Rib Centipede.
Keep the records. Their spines and venom explain the Barbed answer better than another surrendered carcass.
hemomancy.alchemist.armor_research.chiti: Catalog a Chalybeate Snail, a Chitinite, and a Fervent Chitinite.
Keep the records. Their shells show the Artificer where Chitinite armor can yield without breaking.
hemomancy.alchemist.armor_research.prism: Catalog a Prism Cuttle, a Scarlet Serpent, and a Verdigris Moth.
Keep the records. Their changing pigments explain what the Prismatic answer is imitating.
hemomancy.dialogue.event.alchemist_armor: The Alchemist compares your Bestiary notes with the Artificer's work and gives you another matching reagent.
Place a Hematic Armature. Return after the frame has existed in your own workshop.
Use that Armature to complete one Hematic Iron upgrade.
Complete and wear the full Hematic Iron set before the final fitting.
hemomancy.artificer.assignment.three_ans: Make your first Barbed, Chitinite, or Prismatic armor piece. The first family is the answer I will record.
Take my recorded answer to an Alchemist. They can match its reagent and identify useful Bestiary specimens.
Complete and wear the full set from your recorded family.
Prove the set answers in the field: retaliation, projectile reduction, or prismatic flash.
hemomancy.artificer.assignment.crimson_v: Apply the Vicar's Consecration Kit to the Armature.
Carry my inspection to an Alchemist and receive Crimson Lacquer.
Complete the first Blood Lust upgrade.
Complete and wear the full Blood Lust set.
Land a direct hit and make the full vestment draw or bank blood.
hemomancy.artificer.assignment.assumed_l: Complete one Living Weapon Graft rite.
Defeat a hostile with a transformed Living Staff weapon form.
Learn all seven base Living Weapon forms before the final fitting.
hemomancy.artificer.assignment.weight_of: Apply the Monolithic Cornerstone to the Armature.
Complete the first valid D7 armor upgrade. Its lineage will be recorded permanently.
Complete and wear the full set from the recorded D7 lineage.
Successfully activate that lineage's registered armor ability.
hemomancy.dialogue.event.artificer_rewar: That material has not been earned, or was already issued.
hemomancy.dialogue.event.artificer_equip: the full recorded set is equipped
equip the full recorded set first
hemomancy.dialogue.event.artificer_three: Recorded fork: %1$s. %3$s. Take the inspection to an Alchemist; they can compare it with your Bestiary records.
hemomancy.dialogue.event.artificer_crims: The consecrated frame holds. %3$s. Take my referral to an Alchemist.
hemomancy.dialogue.event.artificer_weigh: Recorded D7 lineage: %2$s. %3$s. Its matching material has been issued.
hemomancy.dialogue.event.artificer_d7_re: The material matches the first lineage. Later upgrades will not rewrite it.
advancements.hemomancy.artificer_weight_: Return to the Artificer for the recorded lineage material.
screen.hemomancy.harbinger_assignment_le: Return for inspection and four Hematic Iron Scrap.
Wear the full set and claim its fitting.
Return so the first family can be recorded.
Take the referral to an Alchemist for a reagent and specimen study.
Trigger that set's real defensive response.
Receive Crimson Lacquer from an Alchemist.
Complete and wear the Blood Lust set.
Trigger direct-hit lifesteal or borrowed blood.
Return for the Crimson Vestment Fitting.
Reach Degree 5 and bond a Living Staff.
Receive the Living Weapon graft briefing.
Return for inspection and a Blank Hematic Memory.
Defeat a hostile with a transformed Living Staff.
Learn all seven base weapon forms. %1$s/%2$s

Return so its first lineage can be recorded.
