hemomancy.manipulation.crimson_coronatio: Forms up to eight blood lances that retaliate when their bearer is struck.
hemomancy.manipulation.sovereign_instinc: When surrounded and struck, turns blood-bearing attackers against one another.
hemomancy.manipulation.synaptic_storm.de: Chains a charged paralytic current through up to eight nearby enemies.
hemomancy.manipulation.living_circuit.de: Channels speed and haste into nearby allies and arms their next strike with Conductive Mark.
hemomancy.manipulation.white_verdict.des: Projects a charged piercing beam that exposes and punishes concealed targets.
hemomancy.manipulation.vigil_of_glass.de: Greatly reduces distant projectile harm and exposes its shooter.
hemomancy.manipulation.furnace_veins.des: Channels a close heat field that burns enemies and frees allies from frost.
hemomancy.manipulation.phoenix_debt.desc: Arms a shared Last Rite, paying a vast blood debt to survive lethal harm and erupt in cleansing flame.
hemomancy.manipulation.absolute_stillnes: Channels a freezing field that slows projectiles, smothers fire, and locks enemies in rime.
hemomancy.manipulation.rimebound_sentenc: Condemns a targeted enemy to charged frost damage and temporary confinement.
hemomancy.manipulation.hematic_ballast.d: Automatically anchors the body against a powerful launch or knockback.
hemomancy.manipulation.iron_choir.desc: Channels a ferric guard that intercepts one hostile projectile with each pulse.
hemomancy.manipulation.funeral_bell.desc: Detonates Wither, Poison, Blood Loss, and Grave Debt across a charged deathly pulse.
hemomancy.manipulation.carrion_communion: Drains afflicted nearby enemies while channeled and returns part of their life.
hemomancy.manipulation.penumbral_drift.d: Channels a swift invisible drift that ends when the caster attacks.
hemomancy.manipulation.eclipse_well.desc: Creates a charged well of darkness that blinds, pulls, and breaks hostile sight.
screen.hemomancy.scars.lore.scar_anvil: The Anvil fixes iron into the blood, the joints, and finally the earth beneath them. The practitioner becomes nearly immovable, and every step carries that same weight.
screen.hemomancy.scars.lore.scar_blight: The Blight turns the practitioner's own toxins outward. The body learns to treat poison as a weapon, though the same venom can still read its bearer as the wound.
screen.hemomancy.scars.lore.scar_blood_h: The Blood-Honed Scar lets an enchanted edge draw strength from the blood behind it. The deeper the weapon's enchantment bites, the more blood the strike spends.
screen.hemomancy.scars.lore.scar_chimera: Two bodies move through one vessel. The Chimera quickens the strike, the step, and the heartbeat until armor becomes dead weight and the body starts feeding the pace.
screen.hemomancy.scars.lore.scar_corona: The Corona drives Flammeus discipline to its final stage. Every strike burns hotter, the body stands firm against impact, and armor blisters away while the veins keep feeding the heat.
screen.hemomancy.scars.lore.scar_crucibl: The Crucible demands motion and returns iron. Blood settles into armor, toughness, and a deeper Iron Heart, leaving the practitioner built like a wall and forced to move like one.
screen.hemomancy.scars.lore.scar_descend: The Descendence aligns blood with the deep cold. The practitioner crosses frozen ground with extraordinary speed, but the cold reaches the hands and drains force from every slower strike.
screen.hemomancy.scars.lore.scar_eye: The Eye carves sight directly into the hemomantic lattice. Darkness opens around the practitioner while each moment of that vision drains blood and each quick step leaves less force behind the blow.
screen.hemomancy.scars.lore.scar_feral: The Feral reaches beneath doctrine for the hunger that came before it. The hand strikes faster, but the skin gives up some of the armor it once carried.
screen.hemomancy.scars.lore.scar_flux: The Flux keeps blood from settling into one shape. Strikes arrive faster as armor loosens around the changing form, so every gain in speed leaves the vessel easier to open.
screen.hemomancy.scars.lore.scar_glacier: The Glacier slows the hands so the rest of the body can move with cold precision. The practitioner gains speed across the field, but every strike must drag itself through the frost first.
screen.hemomancy.scars.lore.scar_halo: The Halo follows those who learned to endure. It hardens the body against heavy blows, then makes every step feel the weight of that protection.
screen.hemomancy.scars.lore.scar_heart: The first scar is also the most honest. The Heart gives the vessel more life by narrowing the blood it can hold, so survival grows while the power available to spend grows smaller.
screen.hemomancy.scars.lore.scar_marrow: The Marrow reaches past blood and into the reserve buried in bone. The vessel gains more life, then pays for that depth with a smaller blood pool and a heavier step.
screen.hemomancy.scars.lore.scar_moon: The Moon aligns blood with a rhythm the practitioner cannot command. The shadow carries the body faster while each blow lands with less force, an ebb and flow written into motion.
screen.hemomancy.scars.lore.scar_oblivio: The Oblivion strips away whatever a vessel can spare. Its bearer strikes harder while health and blood drain with the same steady appetite.
screen.hemomancy.scars.lore.scar_phoenix: The Phoenix pours vitality back into a vessel prepared to burn for it. More life survives inside the body, but the blood pool closes tight and every step slows under the cost of carrying it.
screen.hemomancy.scars.lore.scar_pyre: The Pyre sharpens the strike by feeding protection into it. The practitioner hits harder because the body has given the blade one less layer to cross.
screen.hemomancy.scars.lore.scar_rime: The Rime sends cold into the legs before it reaches the hands. Movement quickens across the frozen field, then each strike loses time to the ice gathering in the wrists.
screen.hemomancy.scars.lore.scar_shade: The Shade lets the practitioner move through darkness with the speed of a passing thought. The body arrives quickly, but the strike behind it lands with less force.
screen.hemomancy.scars.lore.scar_sol: The Sol teaches blood to answer heat before the mind can. The strike grows sharper as the guard burns away, leaving the practitioner bright, fast to wound, and easier to wound in return.
screen.hemomancy.scars.lore.scar_thorn: Every wound teaches something. The Thorn returns that lesson through tougher armor and a deeper Iron Heart, while the iron added to the blood weighs down the legs.
screen.hemomancy.scars.lore.scar_transce: The Transcendence burns through the limits carried in a practitioner's blood. What remains is harder to break, slower to move, and forced to survive on a thinner blood reserve.
screen.hemomancy.scars.lore.scar_veil: The Veil hides its bearer in plain light. That radiance hardens the body against heavy blows, but it gathers around every movement until speed gives way beneath it.
screen.hemomancy.scars.lore.scar_wither: The Wither pulls vital excess from its target and puts that force behind the practitioner's strike. The vessel gives up part of its own health to keep making the claim.
screen.hemomancy.scars.lore.rhizovitta_c: Rhizovitta Communis roots the vessel into the fungal floor and lets the surrounding mycelium answer blood spent in motion. It feels like buried veins feeding the body from below.
screen.hemomancy.scars.lore.talaromyces_: Talaromyces Minus is a quiet decomposer of dead matter. Once etched into the hemomantic lattice, it leads the hand along ferric seams as if stone were only the next thing waiting to be broken down.
screen.hemomancy.scars.lore.oculiflora_r: Oculiflora Reticularis opens in darkness like an eye grown from hyphae. It catches nearby signals and passes them into forms the wearer's blood can understand.
screen.hemomancy.scars.lore.noctifly_aga: The Noctifly Agaric unfurls pale mycelial wings when the wearer wills it. The fungus carries the practitioner into a hover, closer to being lifted than learning to fly.
screen.hemomancy.scars.lore.putrivora_re: Putrivora Resolvens knows the taste of poison, wither, hunger, and blood loss. It shortens each affliction's meal, then returns what little nourishment the suffering contained.
screen.hemomancy.scars.lore.cryostroma_p: Cryostroma Perdurans forms a cold skin over living mycelium. Motion and casting crack the frost, while stillness conserves blood and gives damaged vascular paths time to close.
screen.hemomancy.scars.lore.antiphonomyc: Antiphonomyces Resonans answers impact with a counter-song. Violence enters the body, and the scar teaches the vessel how to echo that force in useful directions.
screen.hemomancy.scars.lore.saprovitta_v: Saprovitta Vestigium leaves a feeding wake behind the moving practitioner. Anyone who follows steps into hungry blood-fungus and meets the garden's appetite firsthand.
